多智能体系统

[MA-0] Multimodal Embodied Agents : A Unified Capability-centric Perspective from Computer-Use to Robot-Use

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多模态代理（Multimodal Agents, MMAs）从计算机使用场景向机器人应用迁移时所面临的核心挑战，即如何在物理世界中实现可靠、可验证的决策与行动。其关键在于提出一个以功能为中心的统一框架——PAPAV（Perceive, Anticipate, Plan, Act, Verify），将多模态具身代理（Multimodal Embodied Agents, MMEAs）的能力解耦为五个核心功能：感知当前状态、预测动作后果、规划可行路径、通过接口或身体执行动作以及验证结果。该框架突破了传统架构依赖的局限，强调功能本质而非具体实现方式，从而能够系统性地比较MMEAs、MMAs与机器人系统（Robotic Systems, RSs）之间的差异。研究指出，物理约束（如部分可观测性、不可验证结果等）显著减少了预先可确定的选择空间，降低了错误修正的可能性，而现有评估体系过度聚焦于“执行”（Act）环节，仅有少数任务评估“预测”（Anticipate）和“验证”（Verify）能力，导致后两者在任务成功指标下被隐匿。因此，PAPAV的核心贡献在于提供了一个跨模态、跨系统的统一评估基准，推动对五项核心能力的显式建模与测量，超越单一任务成功率，为设计高可靠性物理代理提供了理论基础与实践路径。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30108
作者: Yanzhe Chen,Ziyi Yang,Jifeng Zhu,Qiming Huang,Ruihe An,Peiyao Xu,Hesen Yang,Runda Liu,Chang Gong,Zhijun Cao,Zechen Bai,Wenzheng Zeng,Yiqi Lin,Guoqiang Liang,Kevin Yuchen Ma,Kevin Qinghong Lin,Mike Zheng Shou
机构: 未知
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Multimedia (cs.MM)
备注: Project website: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multimodal agents (MMAs) sustain interaction through reasoning, memory, tools, and feedback, most visibly as computer-use agents, while robotic systems (RSs) couple sensing and actuation under physical dynamics. We define multimodal embodied agents (MMEAs) as goal-directed systems that couple multimodal task reasoning with physical action and revise decisions from the resulting feedback. This raises a central question: what changes when a multimodal agent moves from computer-use to robot-use? We introduce PAPAV, a unified capability-centric framework of five recurring functions: Perceive the current state, Anticipate action effects, Plan a feasible course, Act through an interface or body, and Verify the outcome. Defined by function rather than architecture, these capabilities let PAPAV identify what all three share and then compare MMEAs with MMAs and with RSs. Five physical constraints, from partial observability to unverifiable outcomes, leave fewer choices fixed in advance and less room to reverse errors. Across 64 benchmarks, explicit evaluation centers on Act; only 5 assess Anticipate and 3 assess Verify, leaving both largely hidden behind task success. These constraints also frame the open challenges we identify. PAPAV therefore provides a common basis for designing reliable physical agents and measuring progress across all five capabilities rather than task success alone.

[MA-1] Implementation of Dynamic Microsegmentation for a Multi-Robot Network

【速读】：该论文旨在解决物联网（Internet of Things, IoT）网络中，尤其是多机器人网络环境下，传统静态安全防护机制难以应对动态威胁与复杂拓扑变化的问题。其核心挑战在于如何在保障系统正常运行的同时，实现对潜在威胁的实时隔离与响应。解决方案的关键在于采用商用软件定义微分段（software-defined microsegmentation）工具，构建细粒度、动态可调的微分段策略，依据设备的功能属性和健康状态标签（asset functional and health tags）自动调整网络隔离规则，并通过自动化机制实现策略的实时部署。实验表明，该方案能够在不干扰正常业务的前提下，实时自动隔离指定威胁，验证了微分段技术在IoT网络中实现高韧性安全防护的可行性与有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30102
作者: Vishwam Raval,Jaewon Kim,Ravi Pattabhi,Sandip Roy
机构: Global Cyber Research Institute (全球网络研究学院); Texas AM University (德州农工大学); ColorTokens Inc (ColorTokens公司)
类目: ystems and Control (eess.SY); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Networking and Internet Architecture (cs.NI); Robotics (cs.RO)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:This report describes a laboratory instantiation of a dynamic microsegmentation function for an Internet-of-Things network, specifically a multi-robot network, using a commercial software-defined microsegmentation tool. Fine-grained dynamic segmentation policies are defined, where segments are adapted based on asset functional and health tags. Automated implementation of the dynamic policies in software is also undertaken. The microsegmentation solution is shown to automatically isolate an indicated threat in real time, while maintaining unaffected operations. The demonstration indicates that microsegmentation can be implemented in IoT networks, in a way that allows for robust operation in the face of threats and disruptions.

[MA-2] Parallel AI Agent Collaboration as Graph-Structured Distributed Block Optimization

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体并行协作中局部优化导致全局解质量下降的协调问题，即多个独立智能体在各自任务上产生有效局部改进（local edits）时，若直接合并其结果，可能因冲突而破坏共享解决方案的整体性能。其核心挑战在于如何在保持局部改进有效性的同时，实现安全且高效的全局融合。解决方案的关键在于将该问题建模为具有精确可评估目标函数与已知依赖图（dependency graph）的离散块优化问题，并引入**独立集（independent set）**来识别兼容的局部修改，这些修改在相同当前解下的验证增益可精确相加。通过设计一个协调者（coordinator）机制，不仅能够构造安全的兼容候选方案，还可评估交互性修改以捕捉有利协同效应。理论证明表明，最优分数着色（fractional coloring）所对应的合并策略能保证保留至少 1/χf(G)1/\chi_f(G)1/χf​(G) 倍的总验证局部改进量，其中 χf(G)\chi_f(G)χf​(G) 为依赖图的分数染色数，该下界在仅从原提议中选择子集的合并策略中是紧的。在局部改进满足条件性保障及块误差有界的前提下，重复协作可实现目标差距的几何收敛。收敛速率分离了任务结构、智能体分配与计算成本，从而导出用于智能体分配的线性规划模型以及明确的时间-成本权衡关系。实验验证表明，基于验证的合并机制能有效化解个体有益但相互冲突的代码修复修改，避免简单拼接失败；在无冲突的大规模任务中，并行智能体显著降低建模完成时间，尽管需更高的输入令牌等价成本；在三个公开道路网络上，分数集成方法在90次配对运行中持续保留922单位经验证的最小割改进；对于共享车辆路径的路径搜索智能体，分数调度在12次配对运行中使测量墙时长中位数减少15%，同时路径成本变化符合预期波动。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30074
作者: Hanmin Li,Yury Demidovich,Peter Richtárik
机构: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (阿卜杜拉国王科技大学)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Optimization and Control (math.OC)
备注: 24 pages, 8 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Parallel AI agents can produce useful local edits yet degrade a shared solution when their edits are combined. We model this coordination problem as discrete block optimization with an exactly evaluable objective and a known dependency graph. Independent sets certify compatible edits whose verified gains, measured against the same current solution, add exactly. A coordinator constructs a safe compatible candidate and can also evaluate interacting edits to capture favorable interactions. We prove that an optimal fractional coloring yields a merger that preserves a 1/\chi_f(G) fraction of the total verified local improvement, where \chi_f(G) is the graph’s fractional chromatic number. This guarantee is tight among mergers that select a subset of the same proposals. Under conditional local-improvement guarantees and a block error-bound condition, repeated collaboration converges geometrically in the objective gap. The rate separates task structure, agent allocation, and computation cost, yielding a linear program for agent assignment and an explicit time-cost trade-off. Code-repair experiments show that verified merging resolves conflicts between individually useful edits that cause naive merging to fail. On larger conflict-free tasks, parallel agents reduce modeled completion time at higher input-token-equivalent cost. On three public road networks, fractional integration retains 922 units of verified graph-cut improvement across 90 paired runs. For route-search agents sharing exclusive access to vehicle routes, fractional scheduling reduces measured wall time by a median of 15% across twelve paired runs, with route-cost changes varying across runs.

[MA-3] oM2Vec: Continuous Theory-of-Mind Tokens for Multi-Agent Coordination

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）代理在多智能体协作中难以准确构建心智理论（Theory-of-Mind, ToM）的问题，尤其是在文本表示空间中难以有效表征多个潜在的伙伴状态，导致推理能力受限。其核心挑战在于如何在不确定性环境下对合作方的信念、意图和行为进行建模。为此，论文提出ToM2Vec，通过在高维隐空间中使用固定数量的连续推理令牌（reasoning tokens）来学习抽象的心智理论。训练阶段，这些令牌通过监督学习与真实伙伴思想相匹配；测试阶段，各智能体生成自身的ToM令牌，并作为条件信号调控自身的思想与行为。实验在多个环境（如Overcooked-AI、多方谈判、Decrypto、Hanabi及Collab Escape/Capture）中验证了该方法的有效性，结果表明ToM2Vec显著优于基线模型及多种竞争性微调与提示策略。研究进一步证明，隐式推理机制至关重要——当推理以自然语言形式表达时性能明显下降。此外，该方法展现出良好的泛化能力，可在未见过的伙伴模型家族（包括专有模型GPT-5.4）上有效工作。分析还证实，隐空间中的令牌编码的是心智理论信息，而非任务特定特征，具体表现为能显著提升智能体对合作方信念、欲望及下一步动作的预测准确性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.29934
作者: Nithin Sivakumaran,Ali Payani,Hyunji Lee,Mohit Bansal,Elias Stengel-Eskin
机构: UNC Chapel Hill(北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校); Cisco(思科); The University of Texas at Austin(德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: Code: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Forming an accurate theory-of-mind (ToM) is key to successful multi-agent collaboration and requires reasoning under uncertainty to capture multiple possible partner states. This is hard to do in the text representation space native to large language model (LLM) agents, which more easily describe a single partner state. To address this challenge, we introduce ToM2Vec, which learns to form abstract theories-of-mind in a rich latent space via a fixed budget of continuous reasoning tokens. During training, supervision for these tokens comes from the partner’s actual thoughts, which the ToM tokens are trained to abstract and match. At test-time, ToM tokens are generated by each agent and act as conditioners for that agent’s thoughts and actions. Across several environments covering collaborative, competitive, and mixed-motive settings (Overcooked-AI, multiparty negotiation, Decrypto, Hanabi, and Collab Escape/Capture), we evaluate ToM2Vec’s ability to support multi-agent interactions and collaboration, finding consistent improvements over the base model and a variety of competitive trained and prompted baselines. We show that latent reasoning is critical, with performance dropping when reasoning is expressed in text. Moreover, we show that ToM2Vec training generalizes to partner model families not seen at train-time, including a proprietary model (GPT-5.4). In our analysis, we provide evidence that the latent tokens encode a ToM, rather than task-specific information: ToM2Vec’s tokens improve the agent’s ability to directly answer questions about partner beliefs, desires, and next actions.

[MA-4] Conflicted Records: Typed Adversarial Contracts for Auditable LLM Output Quality Enforcement

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）生成记录在生产信息系统中因混合真实事实与幻觉、偏见等质量问题而难以通过传统数据清洗手段有效识别和修复的挑战。现有方法如提示工程、思维链（Chain-of-Thought）及基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）虽能降低表面错误率，但缺乏可审计性，且无法区分真正修复与对错误内容的掩盖式压制。其核心解决方案是提出BiasGuard-D：一种基于多智能体对抗性协作的结构化验证框架，由来自不同模型家族的两个对立角色交换带类型标注的主张文档，三模型共识机制以多数投票裁定结果，并结合参考性检查与语义不变性双重验证来确认裁决。其中，语义不变性组件专门捕捉参考性检查遗漏的缺陷；若移除迭代推理环路，不变性满足率显著下降。实验表明，仅通过角色框架调整，该系统即可实现从刻板印象到幻觉修复的自然转移，在HaluEval问答任务上使正确答案恢复率提升49个百分点；同时，为维持客观幻觉检测的召回率，需引入跨家族第二审计者作为分诊门控。所有主张、投票与指令均以类型化记录形式存档，形成符合新兴人工智能监管要求的可追溯证明链。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.29669
作者: Kardelen Subasi,Jarosław A. Chudziak
机构: Warsaw University of Technology (华沙理工大学)
类目: Databases (cs.DB); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: Accepted at the International Conference on Cooperative Information Systems (CoopIS 2026)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:LLM-generated records increasingly populate production information systems where they are treated as data assets subject to the same quality expectations as records from operational databases. A single such record can simultaneously satisfy and violate a quality rule: a grounded fact adjacent to a hallucination, a useful answer adjacent to a stereotype. Classical data cleaning cannot resolve this because the two judgments are incompatible over the same span; a single LLM judge cannot either, since it shares the training biases that produced the conflict. Existing interventions such as prompt engineering, chain-of-thought, and RLHF reduce surface error rates but provide no audit trail and cannot distinguish genuine remediation from blanket suppression. The question is whether a deterministic check over structured inter-agent records can catch the defects that referential checks alone miss. We present BiasGuard-D: two adversarial roles drawn from distinct model families exchange typed claim documents, a three-model quorum adjudicates by majority vote, and a combined referential-plus-semantic invariant validates the verdict. The semantic component fires on verdicts referential checks miss; removing the iterative loop drops invariant satisfaction sharply. The deliberation layer transfers from stereotype to hallucination remediation on HaluEval QA with only role-framing changes, raising right-answer recovery by 49 percentage points; the triage gate required a cross-family second auditor to maintain recall on objective hallucination. Every claim, vote, and instruction is stored as a typed record giving operators a provenance trail auditable under emerging AI regulations.

[MA-5] OACap: Caption-Guided Active Observation for Detailed Video Captioning

【速读】：该论文旨在解决开放性视频详细描述（open-ended detailed captioning）中缺乏对感知目标明确指定的问题，即模型需自主判断应获取哪些证据并将其整合为连贯的全局描述。其核心挑战在于如何在信息缺失或不充分时主动生成针对性的观察请求，并通过时空工具获取证据，进而迭代验证与修正生成的描述。解决方案的关键是提出一种以描述为中心的自适应观测代理——观察自适应视频描述生成器（OACap），该模型能够将未支持或缺失的信息转化为目标导向的观测请求，利用时空分析工具主动获取视觉证据，并通过多轮迭代实现对描述内容的持续优化。此外，为更精准评估模型所保留信息的质量，研究引入了事实-语义视频描述基准测试（FSCap-Bench），其中核心支持事实准确率（CSFS）结合了断言精确性与重要性感知的事实覆盖率，能有效响应四种受控扰动；跨模态语义往返评分（CSRS）则通过视频-描述-视频-描述的闭环匹配原子事实，衡量语义保真度。二者共同建立了下游文本记忆效用与事实准确性、语义完整性之间的可量化关联。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.29327
作者: Hao Shi,Hong Yan,Xiaoyang Zhang,Qing Cui,Chao Huang
机构: Ant Group; Zhejiang University(浙江大学); Peking University(北京大学)
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Multimedia (cs.MM)
备注: 14 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Technical report

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Unlike question answering, where a query specifies a perceptual target, open-ended detailed captioning must determine what evidence to acquire and how to integrate it into a coherent global description. We propose Observation-Adaptive Video Captioner (OACap), a caption-centered agent that turns unsupported or missing information into targeted observation requests, uses spatiotemporal tools to acquire evidence, and iteratively verifies and revises the caption. OACap captions consistently improve performance across general video-understanding benchmarks using a fixed text-only reader. To better diagnose the information they preserve, we introduce Factual-Semantic Captioning Bench (FSCap-Bench). Its Core-Support Factuality Score (CSFS) combines claim precision with importance-aware fact coverage and responds as expected to four controlled perturbation types on 93.0-98.3% of valid caption pairs. Its Cross-Modal Semantic Round-Trip Score (CSRS) measures semantic preservation through a video-caption-video-caption round trip by matching atomic facts from source and recovered captions. Together, they connect downstream textual-memory utility with factual and semantic preservation.

[MA-6] When Are We Near Nash? Certifying Solutions in General-Sum Games

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在非零和广义扩展形式博弈（general-sum extensive-form games）中，如何无需额外计算最优回应（best response）即可对启发式求解器产生的迭代策略序列进行在线验证的问题。其核心挑战在于：求解器虽能维护后悔累积量（regret accumulators）与终局分布累积量（terminal-distribution accumulators），但难以直接评估当前策略的纳什差距（NashGap）。论文提出的关键解决方案是构建一种“零最优回应”（zero-best-response）证书机制，该机制利用当前策略的加权平均形式与后悔累积量之间的理论关系，在两玩家博弈中将纳什差距分解为加权外部后悔与一个带符号的价值修正项。通过将后悔值由反事实后悔累积量（counterfactual-regret accumulator）进行上界估计，该证书可在线生成，每检查点开销仅线性于终局历史数，并且在交替更新及三名以上玩家博弈中仍保持有效性。其关键创新在于引入一个单次逆向传递（backward pass）完成的比较器项（comparator term），用于捕捉交替更新带来的偏差，从而实现无需最佳回应即可获取严格纳什差距上界的验证。实验表明，采用一组无训练的后悔匹配求解器（training-free regret-matching solvers）并选取最小证书的迭代解，可在多个基准测试集上以高精度（最高达92%）成功验证纳什近似解，且其精确比较器改进版本可对所有求解实例实现完全认证。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.29300
作者: Boning Li,Longbo Huang

Abstract:Heuristic solvers for general-sum extensive-form games produce a stream of iterates, and practice reports the NashGap of the returned profile. We ask what a solver can know about its own iterates from the regret accumulators and the terminal-distribution accumulators its updates already maintain. In two-player games the NashGap of a weighted average strategy equals, at the maximizing player, the weighted external regret plus a signed value correction. Bounding the regret by the running counterfactual-regret accumulator gives an online certificate whose cost per checkpoint is linear in the number of terminal histories. The certificate stays sound under alternating updates and in games with three or more players. The mismatch between what alternation evaluates and what the averages record enters as one signed comparator term, maximized in a single backward pass per player whose comparator weight is nonzero. The bound is read off the regret state, with no best response against the average. Run a portfolio of training-free regret-matching solvers, output the iterate with the smallest certificate, and verify that iterate once. On the benchmark’s biased Leduc family a pool of sixteen training-free solvers, seven original and nine recent variants, solves 89% of the 64 instances at threshold 10^-5 this way, matching the trajectory-minimum union of the solvers. The same protocol solves 92% of the 64 pre-registered held-out instances and 89% again on a third set of 64 instances that no earlier stage used. The zero-best-response certificate certifies all 57 in-sample solves and all 57 fresh ones, and 58 of the 59 held-out ones. Its exact-comparator refinement certifies every solve in the three sets. The certificate states both and attributes its bound. Code is available at this https URL.

[MA-7] Credit Where Credit Is Due: Contrastive Attribution Topology Search for Multi-Agent Systems

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大型语言模型多智能体系统（LLM multi-agent system, MAS）中智能体拓扑结构选择的难题，即如何在复杂且异质的智能体集合中识别出高效、可靠且低成本的协作团队。现有方法通常依赖单一任务得分进行启发式搜索，但无法揭示各智能体对整体性能的实际贡献或负面影响，导致难以优化拓扑结构并可能引入有害行为。其解决方案的关键在于提出对比归因拓扑搜索（Contrastive Attribution Topology Search, CATS），通过一个基于大模型的归因器（LLM attributer）对比不同候选拓扑的执行轨迹，量化每个智能体的贡献度（即“信用”）。基于这些信用评分，CATS动态调整超图（supergraph）中的边权重，并逐步剪枝低效边与表现差的智能体，最终生成紧凑高效的部署团队。实验表明，相较于仅依赖任务得分的启发式搜索，CATS在BigCodeBench上提升了5.3个百分点的平均准确率，同时减少54%的部署令牌消耗；在MBPP上达到最强基线性能，且用更少的计算资源完成任务；在HotpotQA对抗性提示攻击测试中，三次运行均成功排除所有恶意诱导的智能体，而随机搜索仍保留部分有害智能体。因此，基于个体信用的归因机制不仅实现了团队性能优化，还具备识别并剔除潜在威胁智能体的能力，显著增强了系统的鲁棒性与可解释性。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:An LLM multi-agent system (MAS) is only as good as the agents it chooses to trust: its accuracy and cost hinge on its topology, meaning which agents are included and how they communicate. A single task score, however, does not reveal which agents help or hinder performance. We propose Contrastive Attribution Topology Search (CATS), which searches for compact teams within a fixed supergraph of specialized agents. An LLM attributer compares execution traces across candidate topologies and assigns credit to individual agents. CATS uses these credits to update supergraph edges while progressively pruning weak edges and agents, yielding a small team for deployment. With small open-weight models and matched candidate evaluations, CATS improves mean accuracy on BigCodeBench by 5.3 percentage points over score-only heuristic search while using 54% fewer deployment tokens. On MBPP, CATS matches the strongest baselines with fewer tokens than the other searches. In a HotpotQA prompt-poisoning stress test, CATS excludes all adversarially prompted agents in all three runs, whereas random search retains some at comparable accuracy. Per-agent credit thus supports both team optimization and the pruning of potentially harmful agents.

[MA-8] Design and Tuning of Multi-Agent Systems Using Bayesian Evolutionary Optimization

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统（Multi-Agent System, MAS）设计中存在的人工干预成本高、拓扑结构优化效率低的问题，尤其在评估代价高昂的场景下如何高效探索最优架构。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种贝叶斯进化优化框架，通过结合进化算子生成多样化的工作流图，并利用贝叶斯优化中的图感知高斯过程（graph-aware Gaussian Process）与期望改进（Expected Improvement）准则，实现对高价值候选解的精准筛选。相较于基于大语言模型（LLM）的候选选择方法，该框架提供了明确且可解释的选择标准，显著提升了在昂贵评估预算下的搜索效率与性能表现。实验结果表明，在BigCodeBench代码生成任务和基于TabPFN的表格预处理基准上，所演化出的MAS架构均达到领先性能，验证了贝叶斯选择机制在引导进化搜索中的有效性。

作者: Dominik Jehle,Tom Zehle
机构: University of Freiburg(弗莱堡大学); Freiburg im Breisgau, Germany(弗莱堡, 德国)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Designing effective multi-agent systems (MAS) remains a challenging and resource-intensive task. We propose a Bayesian Evolutionary Optimization framework for automatically discovering task-specific MAS topologies. The approach combines evolutionary operators to generate diverse workflow graphs with Bayesian optimization to focus cost intensive evaluations on promising candidates. In contrast to LLM-based candidate selection, our approach uses a graph-aware Gaussian Process and Expected Improvement to provide an explicit selection criterion during evolutionary search. We evaluate the method on BigCodeBench for code generation and on a tabular preprocessing benchmark using TabPFN. On BigCodeBench, evolved architectures achieve the highest overall performance among the evaluated agent systems. On temporal tabular datasets, optimized MAS preprocessing improves over the default TabPFN model on several tasks, while remaining competitive on IID datasets. Overall, the results demonstrate the potential of Bayesian selection for guiding evolutionary MAS search under expensive evaluation budgets.

[MA-9] MA-UITD: Offline Multi-Agent Reward Inference for Characterizing Continuous Social Behavior

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体逆强化学习（multi-agent inverse reinforcement learning）中从联合演示数据中推断个体化奖励函数的难题，尤其针对交互行为既受自身偏好又受对他人行为预期影响这一核心挑战。现有方法通常依赖环境交互、重复策略优化作为内循环，或对环境动态和动作空间施加严格假设，难以适用于固定行为数据集。本文提出一种离线方法——多智能体单边逆时差学习（MA-UITD），其关键在于通过信念条件化的继承特征（belief-conditioned successor features）表征每个智能体自身行为的长期后果，并对其他智能体的行为进行平均建模，从而解耦个体偏好与社会预期。通过共享奖励特征与智能体特异性偏好向量将单边价值映射至目标奖励函数，结合逆时差一致性约束与噪声对比行为学习机制，实现无需已知环境动态或内层策略优化循环的奖励推断。在模拟的合作、竞争及一般和任务中，MA-UITD在离散动作场景下优于基线方法，并在连续动作场景中成功推断出符合行为表现的奖励结构；应用于实验采集的社会觅食轨迹时，成功揭示了领导者与追随者在空间位置与互动依赖性上的差异化奖励结构，为理解社会行为背后的神经计算机制提供了可量化的潜在目标表征。

Abstract:Multi-agent inverse reinforcement learning offers a powerful framework not only for imitation learning but also for understanding the neural computations supporting social interactions and decision-making. Inferring rewards from interacting agents is challenging because observed choices reflect both personal preferences and expectations about others. Existing methods often require additional environment interaction, repeated policy optimization as an inner loop, or restrictive assumptions about environment dynamics and action spaces, limiting their applicability to fixed behavioral datasets. We introduce Multi-Agent Unilateral Inverse Temporal Difference Learning (MA-UITD), an offline method for inferring explicit agent-specific rewards from joint demonstrations in continuous-state environments with either discrete or bounded continuous actions. Its core idea is to represent the long-term consequences of each agent’s own actions through belief-conditioned successor features that average over other agents’ behavior. Shared reward features and agent-specific preference vectors connect these unilateral values to the target reward function, while inverse temporal-difference consistency and noise-contrastive behavioral learning enable inference without known dynamics or an inner policy-optimization loop. Across simulated cooperative, competitive, and general-sum tasks, MA-UITD outperforms baselines in discrete-action settings and infers behaviorally compatible reward profiles in continuous-action settings. When applied to experimentally collected social-foraging trajectories, MA-UITD inferred distinct spatial and interaction-dependent reward structures for leaders and followers, providing a quantitative characterization of latent behavioral objectives that may be relevant for understanding the neural computations underlying social behavior.

[MA-10] Resonance and Depth: Composing Timbral Identity and Spatial Form in an Artist-in-the-Loop Co-Creative Multi-Agent Percussive Performance

【速读】：该论文旨在解决传统音乐创作中以和声发展为核心、忽视音色（timbre）与空间感作为主要构成要素的问题，特别是在沉浸式电子音乐表演中如何实现音色身份与音乐形式的动态生成。其解决方案的关键在于构建一个“艺术家在环路中的协同创作多智能体系统”（artist-in-the-loop co-creative multi-agent system），通过实时重组、空间化处理及人机交互，将演奏者的现场素材经由拼贴合成（concatenative synthesis）、音频镶嵌（audio mosaicing）、符号中介（symbolic mediation）、物理启发合成（physically inspired synthesis）以及基于对象的空间化（object-based spatialisation）等技术手段进行再创造。该系统将空间参数（位置、轨迹、深度、扩散、宽度、表观尺寸）视为主动参与音乐句法与结构建构的作曲材料，从而在人、算法、音色与空间的多重过程中实现表演者身份的持续保留、转化与重新分配，形成一种新型的沉浸式协同创作生态。

Abstract:This research-creation artistic report presents Resonance and Depth, a 9-minute immersive electroacoustic/acousmatic performance that treats timbre and space as primary compositional materials. Built from live electronic percussion and a personal corpus recorded, curated, and composed by the author, the work investigates how timbral identity and musical form can emerge through real-time recombination, spatialisation, and performer-system interaction rather than conventional harmonic development. The performance is realised as an artist-in-the-loop co-creative multi-agent system integrating MACAT, MACataRT, a MIDI-based musical agent, a spatialisation layer, and a conductor agent. These components recombine and transform the performer’s material through concatenative synthesis, audio mosaicing, symbolic mediation, physically inspired synthesis, and object-based spatialisation. The work approaches spatialisation as an active compositional process in which position, trajectory, depth, diffusion, width, and apparent size participate in musical phrasing and form. Through this practice-based framework, Resonance and Depth examines how performer identity can be retained, transformed, and redistributed across human, algorithmic, timbral, and spatial processes within an immersive co-creative performance ecology.

[MA-11] he Butterfly Effect in LLM Social Simulations: From Architecture Sensitivity to Robustness Audits

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在社会模拟中因局部扰动传播而导致集体结果显著偏离的“蝴蝶效应”问题。这一现象使得科学推断面临严峻挑战：模型实现细节上的微小变化可能通过代理间交互被放大，进而影响基于集体行为得出的科学结论的可靠性。其解决方案的关键在于揭示并量化这种敏感性，提出可系统评估鲁棒性的框架——TRAILS（用于大语言模型模拟鲁棒性审计的分类体系）与社会模拟审计卡（Social Simulation Audit Card），以识别不同层级（表示与设计）扰动对模拟结果的影响，并将科学结论的适用范围校准至支持其的鲁棒性证据之上，从而增强社会模拟研究的可重复性与可信度。

作者: Jinyi Ye,Lei Cao,Ding Chen,Emilio Ferrara

类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:A butterfly effect occurs when a local perturbation propagates through a system and produces divergence in its collective outcome. In LLM social simulations, this creates a particular challenge for scientific inference: sensitivity to implementation choices can enter agent interactions and alter the collective outcomes on which scientific claims are based. We study this problem through a repeated Prisoner’s Dilemma and a social-media echo chamber, spanning representation- and design-level perturbations across four LLM families. We find that controlled perturbations can substantially alter collective outcomes, with sensitivity varying across both perturbations and models. In the Prisoner’s Dilemma, changing only the representation of a matched persona shifts two-agent cooperation by 75.2 percentage points for GPT-5.2, while game framing and memory representation produce smaller or less consistent effects. Multi-agent interaction further reshapes representation sensitivity, producing amplification or attenuation depending on the model and perturbation. In the echo-chamber simulation, persona representation changes interaction targeting and is accompanied by divergence in collective interaction structure, extending representation sensitivity from agent behavior to network-level outcomes. These results show that robustness cannot be inferred from a single simulation configuration and that local sensitivity can change as it propagates through interaction. We introduce TRAILS (Taxonomy for Robustness Audits In LLM Simulations) and the Social Simulation Audit Card as a framework for systematically auditing these dependencies and calibrating the scope of scientific claims to the robustness evidence that supports them.

[MA-12] ransformers as Generic Deep Neural Networks: Exact Compilation the Cost of Removing Activation-Activation Products and Multi-Agent Attention Clustering

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）中 Transformer 模型在硬件部署时因专用算子和量化算法带来的计算冗余与效率瓶颈问题。其核心挑战在于：尽管神经处理单元（NPU）为注意力机制和层归一化（LayerNorm）引入了专用操作，且量化依赖于 Transformer 特有的算法，但这些设计实际上并非必要。论文提出的关键解决方案是：将每个 Transformer 块（包含注意力、LayerNorm 和 GELU 激活的 MLP）精确编译为仅由固定仿射变换、路由逻辑以及平方、Sigmoid 与反平方根等基本非线性操作构成的通用深度神经网络，同时使用 GELU 或其 Sigmoid 近似替代传统激活-激活乘积。通过避免引入额外的非线性运算类型，该方法可消除每头（per-head）密集注意力得分计算中至少 N2N^2N2 个标量非线性评估开销。由于 Sigmoid 与反平方根操作在所有调研的 NPU 上均支持逐元素形式，因此无需专用硬件即可高效实现。进一步地，针对 Top-kkk 注意力，论文证明了基于尾部质量（tail mass）的精确或条件均值估计能提供无偏且最小均方误差的注意力分布估计，而尾部丢弃则存在条件偏差；当查询或代理聚类时，通过中心点优先选择键（keys），可将每头的得分计算量从 N2N^2N2 降低至 NkNkNk。在 DeiT-Tiny、MambaIRv2-Light 与 Pythia-70M 上的实验表明，该编译模型在使用全部键的情况下性能与原始模型一致，标准后训练量化（post-training quantization）即可适用，且在关键数 k≤8k \leq 8k≤8 时，尾部质量估计相比尾部丢弃仅需一半键数即达到更优性能。

Abstract:Transformers are deployed as a special model class. Neural processing units (NPU) add dedicated operators for attention and normalization, and quantization relies on Transformer-specific algorithms. We show the computation does not force this. Every Transformer block, with attention, LayerNorm and a GELU MLP, compiles exactly into a generic deep neural network built from fixed affine maps, routing and the square, sigmoid and inverse square root, plus GELU or its sigmoid approximation. Without activation-activation products, every transform-wise compilation adds at least N^2 scalar nonlinear evaluations per head for dense scores. Keeping that one operation type removes this cost; its elementwise form, present on every surveyed NPU, suffices with the sigmoid and inverse square root. For top- k attention with exchangeable tail scores, we prove that exact or conditional-mean tail mass gives an unbiased, minimum-mean-square-error estimate of the attention distribution, while tail drop is conditionally biased. When queries or agents cluster, centroids choose the keys first, reducing the number of computed scores from N^2 to Nk per head. On DeiT-Tiny, MambaIRv2-Light and Pythia-70M the compiled models match their references with all keys, standard post-training quantization applies, and the exact tail-mass estimate beats tail dropping with half as many keys on DeiT-Tiny and, for k\le8 , on Pythia-70M.

Abstract:Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) offers a principled way of populating simulated economies with many heterogeneous decision makers. Its adoption, pioneered in finance, has nonetheless been slow in macroeconomics because of two main limitations: the lack of a shared frame of reference connecting MARL systems to dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) models the profession already trusts, and the very long training times. The first limitation was recently addressed by the Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Business Cycle (MARL-BC), which places deep RL households in a real business cycle economy and reduces to classic DSGE models in specific limits. Here we address the second limitation. We present JaxMARL-BC, a JAX-accelerated simulator that trains MARL-BC economies in seconds (between 75x and 724x faster than the reference implementation), and scales to 200,000 independent learning households. We verify its correctness against the known DSGE limits, characterise its scaling through a simple cost law, and demonstrate its value by a proof-of-concept calibration of an extended model with heterogeneous returns on capital, in a two-hour experiment that would previously have taken over a month. We release JaxMARL-BC as open source.

[MA-14] Fig: Automated Multiagent Behavior Elicitor

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统（Multiagent Systems）中社会行为评估缺乏系统性干预与可控性的问题，现有研究多依赖环境自然涌现的行为，难以实现对特定行为的精准诱发与重复验证。其解决方案的关键在于提出Fig（Finding Interactions in Games）——一个能够执行目标导向干预的代理系统，该系统接收自然语言形式的行为描述，将其分解为子行为，生成或选择新的社会博弈场景，并对游戏引擎、对手、指令及上下文等要素实施单个或组合式干预，以主动诱发目标行为。通过结合内置机械检查与合成评分标准进行评估，该方法在6种测试行为（合作、剥削、欺骗、隐秘协作、背叛、破坏）上使模型在有效生成场景中的行为尝试率达45.2%，且在具备对照条件的游戏-行为对中，干预使行为尝试率平均提升10.9%。结果表明，多智能体环境可作为可编程、可控且可复现的行为评估测试平台。

Abstract:Many social evaluations for multiagent systems study behaviors as they emerge from environments instead of systematically intervening in the environment to elicit such behaviors. We introduce Fig (Finding Interactions in Games), an agentic system that performs targeted elicitation interventions on game environments. It takes a natural language behavior description, decomposes it into sub-behaviors, generates new social games or selects existing ones, and executes single or combined interventions to the games’ engine, opponents, instructions, and context. To evaluate model behavior, it combines built-in mechanical checks and synthetic rubric judgments. We validate the interventions, generated games, and evaluation mechanisms via human review. Models attempt the target behavior in 45.2% of episodes on average for valid scenarios generated by Fig for six test behaviors – cooperation, exploitation, deception, covert coordination, betrayal, and sabotage. For game-behavior pairs with available controls, Fig’s interventions increase attempt rates by 10.9% on average compared to matched control games. Fig shows that multiagent environments can serve as programmable test beds for intentional, controllable, and reproducible behavior evaluation. Code is available at this https URL.

[MA-15] o Manipulate or Not: Opinion Dynamics in LLM Interactions

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在持续对话中相互影响时，传统说服研究仅关注单方影响而忽视双向互动的局限性。其核心问题在于：如何有效衡量和理解多轮对话中不同模型间观点动态变化的本质，特别是模型角色设定与交互模式对观点演变的影响。解决方案的关键是提出一种受控的LLM-LLM辩论框架，通过让两个模型在气候变迁归因这一争议话题上进行多轮对话，其中一方被赋予特定立场甚至明确的说服指令，另一方则保持中立。研究通过追踪双方显式表达的观点及逐轮对话行为特征，揭示了同模型交互通常缩小观点差距，而跨模型交互则扩大差距；同时发现，显式声明与实际对话行为反映的是观点动态的不同维度，且“主动说服”的指令并未显著提升影响力。这表明，对话中的影响力不仅取决于角色设定与初始立场，更深刻依赖于参与模型自身的特性，对评估长程对话中意见转变机制具有重要启示。

作者: Mohammad Siahkamari,Phuoc Dat Nguyen,Stephen MacNeil
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Social and Information Networks (cs.SI)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models increasingly take part in extended conversations where they can both shape and be shaped by another party’s views, yet most persuasion research measures only one side of that exchange. We introduce a controlled LLM-LLM debate framework in which two language-model roles repeatedly discuss a contested topic (climate-change attribution): one is given an assigned stance and, in some conditions, an explicit instruction to persuade, while the other receives no assigned position. Across four ordered model combinations involving GPT-6 Luna and Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite, we track both each role’s explicitly reported position and a separate measure of its turn-by-turn behavior inside the conversation. Opinion dynamics differ substantially across model combinations: same-model interactions narrow the opinion gap on average, clearly for only one of the two models, while cross-model interactions widen it. Explicit reports and in-dialogue behavior capture distinct aspects of opinion dynamics, and a blanket instruction to persuade does not reliably increase influence. These findings suggest that conversational influence depends not only on assigned roles and initial positions but also on the participating models, with implications for how opinion change is measured in extended LLM interactions.

[NLP-0] LongZero: Enhancing Long-Context Reasoning in LLM s from Zero Data

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在长上下文推理能力提升过程中对高质量训练数据的依赖问题。现有强化学习（Reinforcement Learning, RL）方法依赖于人工标注或外部语料库生成的长篇、多样化且可验证的训练数据，但这些数据的获取成本高昂，且随着模型能力增强，高质量外部数据和教师模型愈发稀缺。为应对这一挑战，本文提出一种无需外部数据的自洽强化学习方法——LongZero，其核心创新在于让模型自主生成用于训练的多跳推理任务与多轮检索任务。具体而言，LongZero首先引导模型以紧凑的结构化形式合成问题、答案及支持证据，随后将证据部分独立扩展为长篇多文档上下文，从而构建出具备复杂推理链的长上下文任务。该方法结合自生成的多跳推理与多轮检索任务，并采用广义相对策略优化（GRPO）进行训练。实验在两个主流LLM上针对五个长上下文推理基准测试表明，LongZero不仅具备良好的泛化能力，且性能优于基于外部语料合成数据的基线方法，证明了其在无需外部数据条件下有效提升长上下文推理能力的可行性与潜力。

作者: Zhennan Wan,Jianfei Chen
机构: Tsinghua University (清华大学); BNRist Center (清华-博世联合实验室); THBI Lab (清华大学脑与智能实验室); Tsinghua-Bosch Joint ML Center (清华大学-博世联合机器学习中心)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: Code and data are available at this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Reinforcement learning (RL) is an effective way to strengthen the long-context reasoning of large language models (LLMs), but it needs training data that are long, diverse, challenging, and verifiable. Human annotation of such data is expensive, naturally occurring data are too scarce to sustain RL, and existing synthesis methods depend on external corpora or stronger teacher models, which become harder to obtain as the trained models get stronger. Recently, RL from zero data, in which a model learns from tasks it proposes itself, has achieved excellent performance, but existing methods target short-context tasks. Therefore, we propose \textbfLongZero , a method that lets an LLM improve its own long-context reasoning without any external data. Instead of writing questions and answers over existing documents, LongZero first has the model synthesize the question and answer with its supporting evidence in a compact structured form, and only then separately expands the evidence into a long multi-document context. LongZero combines these self-written multi-hop reasoning tasks with self-written multi-round retrieval tasks and trains the model with GRPO. We evaluate LongZero on two LLMs across five long-context reasoning benchmarks and compare it with RL on data synthesized from external corpora. Experimental results show that LongZero can generalize to real tasks, and outperforms both baselines, suggesting a viable and promising path to improving long-context reasoning of LLMs.

[NLP-1] Environment Duels: A Microcosm of LLM Co-Evolution

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在复杂交互生态系统中作为“创造者”与“求解者”双重角色的能力评估问题，尤其关注模型在生成任务环境及利用提示（hint）求解任务时的表现差异。现有评估方法多聚焦单一能力，难以反映模型在真实协作与竞争场景中的动态互动。为此，作者提出“环境对战”（Environment Duels）这一动态智能体基准，通过让各模型自主设计包含特权提示的任务环境，并由其他模型尝试求解，从而同时评估其环境创作能力与求解能力。该方案的关键在于构建一个可交互、可验证的闭环评估框架：每个模型既是环境的设计者（作者），又是任务的求解者；环境设计需确保具备“提示依赖性”，即只有获得特定提示才能成功求解，从而凸显提示的价值与设计质量。实验表明，求解能力与创作能力具有显著分离性——最强求解者未必是最佳创作者，而较小模型更善于从他人行为中学习，生成更具挑战性的环境和更有效的提示。此外，模型间的对战结果呈现传递性，形成稳定排名；独立作者趋向于收敛到相似环境设计；且通过强化学习实验证明，模型在特定环境上的提示增益与其在未见推理与智能体任务上的性能提升高度相关。这些现象揭示了模型间相互影响的内在机制，为理解大模型如何在开放生态中“教学”“挑战”与“相互学习”提供了可控实验窗口。

类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

Abstract:Through a tangle of real-world interactions, from synthetic training pipelines to data shared on the open web, frontier LLMs absorb what their predecessors and competitors create. How well does each model play its role in this ecosystem, as a creator and as a solver? We introduce Environment Duels, a dynamic agentic benchmark that evaluates both capabilities on interactive environments. Each model writes environments, each with a privileged hint, aiming for tasks that capable solvers fail without the hint and pass with it. Across nine frontier LLMs, solving and authoring prove to be distinct skills: the strongest solvers are not the strongest authors, while smaller models learn more from how others played and write the hardest environments and the most useful hints. Beyond the scores, the pairwise interactions form a microcosm of how models affect one another. Head-to-head outcomes are transitive and so yield a stable ranking; independent authors converge on the same designs; and in a reinforcement-learning study with Qwen3.8-27B, the learner’s hint lift on an author’s environments tracks how much training on those environments improves it on held-out reasoning and agentic benchmarks, whether the environments are its own or another model’s. Each of these patterns has a counterpart in how models shape one another outside the duel. By staging these interactions under controlled conditions, Environment Duels offers a window onto how LLMs teach, challenge and learn from one another. Code is available at this https URL.

[NLP-2] Quant-Arena: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Quantitative Trading Research

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI 在量化投资研究闭环中的有效性问题，即如何评估大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）是否能够自主完成从假设提出、信号构建、历史回测到策略固化并最终在未见数据上实现盈利的完整迭代过程。其核心挑战在于现有基准仅评价公式、代码或单个交易决策，无法全面检验模型在真实市场环境下的端到端策略生成与泛化能力。为此，论文提出 Quant-Arena——一个基于真实A股市场数据的端到端量化研究基准与公开排行榜，要求模型在2022–2023年期间构建特征与股票评分逻辑，并仅接收该阶段的反馈，随后冻结策略以在密封的2024年进行最终评估。评估采用现金账户模拟器，考虑交易约束与成本，包括基于仿真订单簿估算的市场冲击。评分体系以实际超额收益为主，辅以信号质量与特征多样性指标。实验评估了九个前沿模型，其中 GPT-6 Astra 表现最佳，但所有模型均未能在2024年超越等权市场基准，凸显当前LLM在复杂市场环境中生成可持续盈利策略的局限性。Quant-Arena 对所有模型与智能体开放提交，推动对生成式AI在金融建模中实际效能的系统性评估。

作者: Houde Qian,Zheng Jiang,Wenyi Li,Chenxi Xu,Xinjie Lin,Yuzhao Peng,Ruoyu Han,Youjie Zheng,Kaisen Yang,Qinhuai Na,You Fu,Calvin Xiao
机构: Navers Lab, Einsia.AI(艾尼萨人工智能)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computational Engineering, Finance, and Science (cs.CE)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Quantitative research is an iterative loop: a researcher proposes a market hypothesis, implements it as an executable signal, tests it on historical data, and decides what to keep. Existing benchmarks score formulas, code, or individual trading decisions, leaving open whether large language models (LLMs) can complete this loop and produce strategies that work beyond the research period. We introduce Quant-Arena, a benchmark and public leaderboard for end-to-end quantitative research on real A-share market data. A model constructs features and stock-scoring code, receives feedback only on 2022–2023, and freezes one strategy for assessment on the sealed year 2024. A cash-account evaluator applies trading constraints and costs, including market impact estimated from a simulated order book. Scores are dominated by realized excess return and complemented by signal quality and the diversity of features used by the strategy. We evaluate nine frontier models, among which GPT-6 Astra scores highest; yet no model beats the equal-weight market in 2024. Quant-Arena is open to submissions from any model or agent harness.

[NLP-3] Did the Problem Actually Get Harder? Testing LLM s on Paired P and NP-Complete Problems Hardened by Adversarial Multi-Agent Rewriting

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有基准测试无法有效区分问题复杂性类（如NP完全问题，NPC）与多项式时间可解问题（P）之间的本质差异这一关键问题。传统基准往往依赖固定表述或忽略问题的复杂性类别，导致模型可能通过记忆而非真正推理来得分，从而掩盖了其在面对真实计算难度时的能力缺陷。为此，本文提出P2NPCBench，一个包含12个问题族的新型基准，每个NPC问题均与一个结构上仅有一处差异的P类孪生问题配对，且二者共享相同的问题表面形式。其核心解决方案在于采用AgentGAN——一种对抗式多智能体框架，通过生成器不断重写问题表述，直至一组冻结的代码模型无法正确解答，同时由可执行有效性门控确保每次重写保持原问题的答案和复杂性类别不变。最终构建出2,114条经人工验证参考人类解法的“硬化”问题陈述。实验结果表明，所有评估的12个专有及开源模型在NPC问题上的通过率（35.4% pass@1）显著低于其对应的P类孪生问题（63.8%），且95.1%的模型家族对在NPC侧失败更频繁；即使将时间限制扩大十倍，NPC准确率仅从28.5%提升至31.9%，说明失败主要源于程序逻辑错误或崩溃，而非求解速度慢。此外，硬化处理使两类问题间的性能差距从24.8个百分点缩小至14.6个百分点，揭示了部分看似由复杂性决定的性能差异实则源于对教科书式表述的熟悉程度，而非真正的推理能力。

作者: Nurul Labib Sayeedi,Md. Faiyaz Abdullah Sayeedi,Zabir Al Nazi,Mahbub E Sobhani,Shubhashis Roy Dipta
机构: United International University; BRAC University; University of California, Riverside; University of Maryland; Baltimore County
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Many NP-complete (NPC) problems have a polynomial-time § twin that differs in a single structural detail, such as 3- versus 2-colouring a graph. A model that reasons rather than recalls should notice which side of this boundary a problem falls on, yet existing benchmarks either fix the wording of each task or ignore its complexity class, so they cannot separate the two. We introduce P2NPCBench, a benchmark of 12 problem families in which every NPC problem is paired with a P twin posed over the same surface. To remove the textbook cues that enable recall, we build it with AgentGAN, an adversarial multi-agent framework in which a generator rewrites each statement until a panel of frozen code models fails, while an executable validity gate keeps every rewrite answer- and class-preserving. The result is 2,114 hardened statements with hand-verified reference human solvers. Evaluating 12 proprietary and open-source models, we find that every model scores lower on NPC statements than on their P twins (35.4% vs. 63.8% pass@1), and that 95.1% of model-family pairs fail more often on the NPC side. A tenfold time limit raises NPC accuracy only from 28.5% to 31.9%, so failures stem from wrong or crashing programs rather than slow ones. Hardening also narrows the class gap from 24.8 to 14.6 points, showing that part of the apparent gap reflects familiarity with textbook phrasing rather than complexity class.

[NLP-4] VX-One: Typed Calibrated Decision Heads for Real-Time Perimeter Triage - An empirical study of unknown-attack honesty cascade gray zones and calibration under drift

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决网络边界筛查（perimeter triage）中延迟（latency）与语义理解（semantics）之间的权衡问题：传统签名引擎虽具备高速度和格式安全性，但无法识别未知攻击；而生成式模型虽能捕捉深层语义特征，却存在推理延迟高、输出不可解析等缺陷。其解决方案的关键在于提出VX-One——一种参数量为100K–10M的小型多头神经网络，通过多任务联合训练，输出经过温度校准的类型化决策原语（typed decision primitives），包括可校准的二元门控（calibrated gate）、包含显式“未知”选项的封闭集选择（closed-set choice）以及有序评分（ordinal score）。该设计在保持毫秒级低延迟（CPU上p50为0.7–1.7 ms）的同时，实现了对未知攻击类别的有效检测能力，并在多个基准数据集（UNSW-NB15、CIC-IDS2017、EMBER2024）上验证了其在动态漂移环境下的鲁棒性与实用性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30090
作者: Juan S. Santillana
机构: Independent research(独立研究)
类目: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Networking and Internet Architecture (cs.NI)
备注: 11 pages, 7 tables, 1 figure

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Perimeter triage faces a latency/semantics trade-off: signature engines are fast and format-safe but blind to unseen attacks, while generative models are semantic but slow and produce unparseable output. In late 2026 a class of commercial System One decision models (TypeSafe Jev; Microsoft-Decision-1) began selling typed decision primitives - binary gates, closed-set choices, ordinal scores - as product APIs, with no academic treatment. We present VX-One: a small multi-head network (100K-10M parameters) whose outputs are these primitives - a calibrated gate, a choice over a closed candidate set that always includes an explicit unknown option, and an ordinal score, trained multi-task, temperature-calibrated per head (~0.7-1.7 ms p50 on CPU). We evaluate it on UNSW-NB15, CIC-IDS2017, EMBER2024 against calibrated XGBoost, Random-Forest, MLP, Kitsune, and measure a two-phase cascade (Suricata with 52,674 Emerging-Threats rules - VX-One) over five days of CIC-IDS2017. Findings: (i) VX-One wins detection (AUROC/FPR@95%TPR) on UNSW-NB15 and under temporal drift on CIC-IDS2017 (0.711 vs 0.637), but XGBoost wins multi-class attribution on all three benchmarks; (ii) leave-one-family-out gate detects never-seen families on 9/9 UNSW folds yet drops below chance on CIC recon family, and abstention threshold transfers poorly across benchmarks; (iii) on payload-less reconstructions signature engines resolve ~0.1% of flows - gray zone ~99.9% of traffic, recovered by Phase 2 (combined recall =0.978); (iv) calibration collapses under temporal drift (ECE 0.04-0.40) for every method while ranking partially survives. We provide a measured account of where typed calibrated decisions help perimeter triage, and where they fail.

[NLP-5] GoiBERT: Compact Vietnamese Language Models via Two-Stage Knowledge Distillation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决越南语预训练编码器在实际部署中面临的模型体积大、依赖外部分词工具或需多语言词汇表导致计算成本高的问题。现有最强的越南语模型通常为大型多语言模型，难以高效部署。为此，论文提出GoiBERT，一种基于两个互补教师指导的轻量级越南语编码器家族，包含26M和49M参数的两种规模模型，可直接处理原始文本，无需依赖外部分词。其核心解决方案在于：首先由一个使用统一分词器的通用越南语编码器提供通用表示学习；其次，通过一个更大规模的教师模型生成无需人工标注的软标签（soft labels），实现任务层面的指导。实验结果表明，GoiBERT-large在8个涵盖文本分类、基于方面的情感分析、自然语言推理和命名实体识别的基准上，以少于一半参数量和两倍吞吐量的表现超越了现有紧凑基线模型。GoiBERT-base仅需基线四分之一的模型规模即可保持99%的性能。分析显示，压缩对情感分析与分类任务影响极小，但在推理和实体识别任务中仍存在显著性能损耗，揭示了未来优化方向。

Abstract:Vietnamese pre-trained encoders have improved rapidly, but the strongest ones are large, multilingual-vocabulary models or depend on external word segmentation, which makes them costly to deploy. We present GoiBERT, a family of two compact Vietnamese encoders with 26M and 49M parameters that operate directly on raw text. GoiBERT learns from two complementary teachers. A same-tokenizer Vietnamese encoder first teaches general-purpose representations. A much larger teacher then provides task-level guidance through soft labels that are generated without ever labeling its own training data. Across eight benchmarks covering text classification, aspect-based sentiment analysis, natural language inference, and named entity recognition, GoiBERT-large achieves the highest average score among non-teacher models. It does so with fewer than half the parameters of the strongest compact baseline and twice its throughput. GoiBERT-base retains 99% of that baseline’s performance at a quarter of its size. Our analysis shows that compression is nearly lossless for sentiment and classification tasks but remains costly for inference and entity recognition, which points to clear directions for future work. Our code and models are available at: this https URL

[NLP-6] Looped Uniform Diffusion Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决统一扩散语言模型（Uniform Diffusion Language Models, UDLMs）在训练过程中因需从可能不可靠的上下文进行去噪而带来的高计算成本问题，即其训练过程相较于掩码扩散语言模型（Masked Diffusion Language Models, MDLMs）更为耗时且资源密集。尽管这一挑战性训练目标提升了下游推理性能，但限制了其实际应用效率。本文提出的解决方案关键在于引入“选择性循环”（selective looping）机制——在每个去噪步骤中递归地重复使用少量早期Transformer层，从而在不改变原始训练目标和采样策略的前提下，显著提升训练效率。实验表明，采用循环机制的UDLM可在保持相同验证集负对数似然（NLL）水平的情况下，相比非循环模型减少高达3.3倍的训练浮点运算量（FLOPs），同时在等效非去噪步数（NFE）预算下，生成困惑度降低达9.8%；进一步研究发现，通过更频繁采样较小的循环次数，可实现12%的推理循环次数减少，且不影响模型精度，从而在训练与推理之间达成更优的效率-性能平衡。

Abstract:Uniform diffusion language models (UDLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising sequences of ordinary vocabulary tokens, any of which may be corrupted and subsequently revised. During training, UDLMs must denoise from a context that may itself be unreliable, whereas masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) always condition on a clean context. This challenging training objective makes UDLMs more FLOP-intensive to train than MDLMs, but it yields stronger downstream reasoning performance. Recently, selective looping, which recursively applies a few early Transformer layers within each denoising step, has been shown to improve training efficiency in MDLMs under an iso-FLOP budget. We investigate looping in UDLMs while keeping the training objective and sampler unchanged. We find that looping significantly improves training efficiency: looped UDLMs reach the validation NLL of a non-looped UDLM trained on about 0.5 trillion tokens with up to 2.8x fewer training FLOPs on OpenWebText and 3.3x fewer on FineWeb-Edu. We also find that, at a matched NFE budget, looped UDLMs reach up to 9.8% lower generation perplexity than the non-looped UDLM, with most gains achieved at moderate loop counts. Finally, we study different loop-count distributions and find that sampling smaller loop counts more frequently during training improves inference efficiency: on downstream tasks, this strategy uses 12% fewer loops than uniform loop-count sampling without degrading accuracy.

[NLP-7] Agent Behavior Maps: Locating Agents by What They Would Do Without Running Them

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）智能体在相同成功率下行为路径差异显著的问题，即如何有效刻画和比较不同LLM-工具组合（LLM-harness combinations）之间的行为相似性与差异性。其核心解决方案是提出一种智能体行为图谱（Agent Behavior Map），通过计算在共享参考轨迹上的中心化动作对数似然值（centered action log-likelihoods），无需对目标智能体进行额外环境回放即可表征其行为特征。该方法的关键在于：在明确假设条件下，推导出坐标距离与轨迹相对熵（trajectory KL）之间的误差界，并验证在8个跨评分模型中，坐标距离的排序与直接测量的轨迹KL排序高度一致；进一步地，在ALFWorld环境中，基于该图谱的坐标能有效预测性能并识别跨模型家族、控制成功概率与模型规模后的深层行为相似性。此外，研究还发现，工具组件间的位移具有近似可叠加性，但其精度随组件与环境的不同而变化，为行为分解与模块化分析提供了新范式。

Abstract:LLM agents with similar success rates can follow different action sequences. An Agent Behavior Map represents LLM-harness combinations using centered action log-likelihoods on shared reference trajectories, without requiring new environment rollouts from the target agent. We derive error bounds relating squared coordinate distances to trajectory KL under explicit assumptions, and across eight cross-scored models the distances track the directly measured trajectory KL in rank order. Across 100 LLMs and four environments, ALFWorld-based coordinates support performance prediction and identify behavioral similarities. In ALFWorld, these similarities persist after controlling for success rates and model size, including across model families. As an extension, harness-component displacements approximately compose, with accuracy varying across components and environments.

[NLP-8] Building Auditable AI Text Detectors with Sparse Autoencoders EMNLP2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式AI文本检测器在关键应用场景（如学术评审、教育评估、招生、新闻报道及内容审核）中面临的可解释性与性能之间的矛盾问题。现有最强的检测方法依赖于微调的神经分类器，其决策过程高度不透明；而透明的替代方案（如基于风格特征和语言学特征的分类器）在性能上存在显著差距。本文提出一种将微调神经检测器转化为基于人类可读概念的可解释分类器的流水线方法：通过在检测器的残差流（residual stream）上直接训练稀疏自编码器（Sparse Autoencoders, SAEs），为每个SAE特征分配可解释标签，并仅保留生成描述通过全局保真度阈值的特征；随后在这些可解释特征上训练轻量级分类器。实验表明，所提取的SAE特征能够捕获高度特定且具有预测性的生成文本“语言线索”（linguistic “tells”），由此构建的分类器不仅具备优异的可解释性，且在分布外（out-of-distribution）文本上的表现优于神经模型和传统风格特征模型。该方案的核心创新在于利用SAEs从深层神经网络中提取可解释的语义特征，实现了高性能与高透明度的统一。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:AI-generated text detectors are increasingly deployed in consequential settings—peer review, education, admissions, journalism, and content moderation—where their outputs directly affect individuals. Yet the strongest detectors are fine-tuned neural classifiers whose decisions are opaque, while transparent alternatives (stylometric and linguistic-feature classifiers) underperform them by wide margins. We present a pipeline that converts a fine-tuned neural detector into a classifier that operates on human-readable concepts. We accomplish this by training sparse autoencoders (SAEs) directly on a detector’s residual stream, assigning auto-interpretation labels to each SAE feature, and retaining only features whose generated descriptions pass a global fidelity threshold. We then train a lightweight classifier on just the interpretable features. We find that our SAEs recover latent concepts that correspond to highly specific and predictive linguistic “tells” of AI-generated text. Classifiers built on these extracted features are not only highly interpretable but exhibit stronger performance on out-of-distribution texts than either neural or stylometric alternatives.

[NLP-9] HiddenLens: A Multi-Layer LLM Framework for Detecting and Resolving Hidden Assumptions in Software Requirements

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决自然语言软件需求中隐含假设（hidden assumptions）难以被发现的问题，这些假设通常涉及性能、运行环境、用户行为及领域约束等非功能性需求（Non-Functional Requirements, NFR），虽在表面上看似清晰合理，却可能在架构设计、测试与部署阶段引发严重风险。若此类假设在实现后才被识别，修复成本将显著上升。现有研究多聚焦于模糊性（ambiguity）和歧义性（vagueness）的检测，而对“看似明确但蕴含潜在假设”的问题关注不足。为此，本文提出HiddenLens——首个专为检测、分类、质疑并解决隐藏假设而设计的六层BERT-LLM集成框架。其核心创新在于构建了一个端到端可解释的分析流程：首先利用BERT注意力熵定位潜在未决片段；继而通过思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）提示的大型语言模型（LLM）推理解析每个假设及其失效风险；第三层采用微调的BERT模型将假设分类至六大NFR类别（性能、安全、可扩展性、可用性、可靠性、领域约束）；第四层基于领域特定（FS）提示生成优先级排序的澄清建议；第五层支持人工验证与编辑；第六层则根据确认结果重写原始需求，生成显式、可测试且可追溯的规范。此外，研究构建了首个专门针对该任务的标注数据集HiddenLens Corpus（HLC），包含312条需求及847个标注的隐藏假设。实验表明，HiddenLens在端到端F1-score上较关键词基线和QuARS-Adapted基线分别提升71%和61%，达到0.79；其基于BERT的NFR分类器F1-score达0.847，验证了该框架在早期识别并消除隐藏假设方面的有效性，从而显著降低软件开发后期的风险与成本。

Abstract:Natural-language software requirements often omit assumptions about performance, operating conditions, user behaviour, and domain constraints, affecting architecture, testing, and deployment. If undiscovered until implementation, resolving them is far more costly than addressing them early. Although ambiguity and vagueness are widely studied, less attention has been given to assumptions embedded in requirements that appear clear and reasonable. We propose HiddenLens, a novel six-layer BERT-LLM pipeline and, to our knowledge, the first framework engineered to detect, classify, question, and resolve hidden assumptions rather than merely flag ambiguity. Layer 1 uses BERT attention entropy to localise unresolved spans; Layer 2 uses CoT-prompted LLM reasoning to articulate each assumption and its failure risk; Layer 3 uses fine-tuned BERT to classify assumptions into six non-functional requirement categories: performance, security, scalability, usability, reliability, and domain; Layer 4 generates ranked clarification options using FS LLM prompting; Layer 5 enables human validation through confirmation, editing, or rephrasing; and Layer 6 rewrites the requirement using the confirmed resolution, producing an explicit, testable, and traceable requirement. We also introduce the HiddenLens Corpus (HLC), comprising 312 requirements annotated with 847 hidden assumptions across six NFR categories. Inspired by PROMISE and PURE, HLC addresses the lack of annotated data for this task and is, to our knowledge, the first dataset developed specifically for it. HiddenLens outperforms keyword-based and QuARS-Adapted baselines by 71% and 61%, respectively, achieving an end-to-end F1-score of 0.79; its BERT-based NFR classifier achieves an F1-score of 0.847. These results indicate that HiddenLens can help analysts resolve hidden assumptions before they propagate through software development.

[NLP-10] Remembering Through Change: Provenance-Preserving Hypergraph Memory for Multimodal Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多模态智能体在长期记忆中难以同时保持细粒度视觉证据并追踪实体跨会话演化状态的问题。现有基于抽象的内存方法将图像压缩为文本，常丢失具有区分性的视觉细节；而像素级保留的内存虽能保存原始观测数据，却难以可靠地将多样化的观测与持久的实体身份关联，并跟踪其状态演变。为此，论文提出一种多模态超图记忆（Multimodal Hypergraph Memory, MHG-Mem），其核心创新在于通过超图结构联合建模实体身份、状态演化及视觉证据溯源。具体而言，MHG-Mem 将不同实体提及及其观测事实表示为独立节点，利用发生超边（occurrence hyperedges）对身份一致的提及和事实进行分组；随后从这些分组观测中合成特定维度的演化状态，并通过演化超边与支持实体、事实及源证据建立关联。为有效导航该结构化记忆，引入基于超图的代理式搜索机制，可自适应选择入口层，沿类型化超边跨层级遍历，并在需要细粒度验证时回溯至原始观测。该设计实现了对跨会话状态变化的推理与细粒度视觉验证的统一支持。在三个基准上的实验表明，相较于最强基线，MHG-Mem 在性能上提升 8.20%–9.98%。

类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

Abstract:Long-term memory for multimodal agents remains challenging, as it must preserve fine-grained visual evidence while tracking entity evolution across sessions. Existing abstraction-based memories compress images into text, often discarding visually discriminative details, whereas pixel-preserving memories retain raw observations but struggle to reliably associate diverse observations with persistent entity identities and track their evolving states. To address these limitations, we propose MHG-Mem, a multimodal hypergraph memory that jointly organizes entity identity, state evolution, and provenance to visual evidence. Specifically, MHG-Mem represents distinct entity mentions and their observed facts as individual nodes, grouping identity-consistent mentions and facts through occurrence hyperedges. It then synthesizes aspect-specific evolution states from these grouped observations and links them to supporting entities, facts, and source evidence through evolutionary and evidential hyperedges. To navigate this structured memory, we introduce hypergraph-based agentic search, which adaptively selects an entry layer, traverses typed hyperedges across memory levels, and inspects source observations when fine-grained verification is required. These designs support both detailed visual verification and reasoning over cross-session state changes. Extensive experiments across three benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of MHG-Mem, improving performance by 8.20-9.98% over the strongest baseline.

[NLP-11] CulturalRiddles: A Multicultural Benchmark of Riddles

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前大语言模型（LLM）在跨文化理解与表征能力评估中存在英语中心主义、文化覆盖范围有限以及对真实文化情境下知识应用能力考察不足的问题。现有评测基准多聚焦于事实性知识，缺乏对文化语境深层理解的考量。为此，研究提出CulturalRiddles这一全新基准，其核心创新在于通过参与式社区协作，由人类原创并构建涵盖62个文化（45个国家、51种语言）的具身化谜题数据集。这些谜题深度植根于特定文化背景，要求模型具备溯因推理（abductive reasoning）、组合推理（compositional reasoning）能力，以及对文化特异性关联、社会常识、语言技能和详尽事实知识的综合理解。实验表明，即使前沿模型在部分文化群体中的准确率也仅达22%。关键解决方案在于构建一个以人类主导、文化原生性为根基的评测体系，并通过公开发布全部资源与开放贡献机制，持续拓展其语言与文化覆盖面，从而推动对模型跨文化认知能力的系统性评估。

Abstract:As LLMs expand their language coverage, evaluating how well they understand and represent diverse cultures becomes increasingly important. However, many benchmarks remain English-centric, with limited cultural coverage and a focus on factual knowledge over its application in real-world cultural contexts. We propose CulturalRiddles, a benchmark of original, culturally grounded riddles created entirely by humans through a participatory community effort, spanning 62 cultures (45 countries, 51 languages). These riddles are deeply rooted in their respective cultures and require abductive and compositional reasoning, alongside detailed factual and social knowledge, language skills, and an understanding of culturally specific associations. We benchmark 28 LLM configurations using both automatic and large-scale human evaluation. Even frontier models achieve at most 22% accuracy in some communities. We publicly release all artifacts alongside an open contribution process to expand the benchmark’s linguistic and cultural coverage.

[NLP-12] Commit or Abstain? System One Decision Models LLM s and Missing Legal Authority

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决法律人工智能（Legal AI）在处理海量法律主张时面临的可扩展性与成本效益问题，尤其关注生成式模型在法律权威验证任务中因强制输出导致的错误引用风险。其核心挑战在于：当前主流的生成式大语言模型（Generative LLMs）在面对无正确选项的情形时仍会强行生成答案，从而产生不可靠甚至误导性的法律引用。解决方案的关键在于引入一种基于校准概率的决策模型（decision model），该模型不生成文本，而是对每个候选法律判例（holding）输出一个经过校准的概率值，并在正确权威缺失时主动“弃权”（abstain）。研究通过扩展CaseHOLD基准，在1670个样本中替换真实持有为非正确项，对比四类决策模型与六种生成式LLM的表现，结果表明：生成式模型在无正确选项情况下仍会在38%-86%的案例中做出选择，而最保守的决策模型仅在30%的情况下做出选择。在标准CaseHOLD测试中，该决策模型以1/55的成本达到与最优生成式模型相当的准确率（88.1% vs. 88.2%）。进一步地，当仅当决策模型与生成式模型意见一致时才采纳其输出，可将错误引用减少一半；此外，通过无监督方式将决策模型的概率分布蒸馏至Qwen3-8B，即可获得一个校准良好且适用于本地部署的轻量级模型。研究表明，法律AI的有效性应以错误引用率为核心评价指标，而非单一依赖准确率。

Abstract:Given the enormous number of claims to be checked, verifiable legal AI requires scalable, cost-effective models that answer the practical needs of law. System One decision models are built on large language models but, instead of generating text, return a calibrated probability for each option. This suits the verification of legal authority, where the question is closed: a given holding, or none of them. We test whether such models abstain when the correct authority is missing. We extend CaseHOLD with an abstention condition in which the correct holding is replaced in 1,670 of 5,314 items, and compare four decision models with six generative LLMs. When no option is correct, generative LLMs still pick one in 38-86% of items; the most cautious decision model does so in 30%. On standard CaseHOLD, a decision model matches the best generative LLM (88.1% vs. 88.2%) at 1/55 of the cost. Accepting that LLM’s answer only when a decision model agrees halves its wrong citations, and distilling a decision model’s probabilities into Qwen3-8B, without labels, yields a well-calibrated local model. Legal AI should be judged by its wrong citations, not by accuracy alone.

[NLP-13] owards English - Mizo Legal Machine Translation: Corpus Creation Analysis and Benchmarks

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决印度本土语言使用者在英语司法程序中因翻译技术匮乏而导致的法律信息获取障碍问题，特别是针对米佐语（Mizo）这一语言资源稀缺的案例。其核心解决方案是构建首个面向印度法院判决书的英-米佐平行语料库，包含来自高哈蒂高等法院和印度最高法院的13,168句对，由专业母语米佐语译者完成全文翻译，并通过人工对齐与双人独立校验确保质量。研究发现，英语词汇在翻译中仅以高度选择性方式借用——法律术语几乎全部保留英文，而日常动作、情境及结果等概念则多用本地化米佐语表达；同时，米佐语变音符号在语料库中使用不一致。基于此数据集，研究对NLLB 200 1.3B模型进行微调，在1,000句对的平衡法律测试集上获得27.47的BLEU分数，相较基线模型提升7.16，但仍存在英文词汇使用频率约为人类译者三倍的问题，表明当前生成式机器翻译仍难以完全模拟自然语言中的语言选择策略。

Abstract:Indian court proceedings are held in English, so speakers of languages with limited translation technology have limited access to them. We present the first English Mizo parallel dataset of Indian court judgments. It contains 13,168 sentence pairs from the Gauhati High Court and the Supreme Court of India. Professional native Mizo translators translated complete documents; sentence pairs were manually aligned, and two independent reviewers checked the results. Our study finds that English words are borrowed in a very selective way: official and legal terms are almost always kept in English, but words for everyday things like actions, situations, and results are usually expressed in native Mizo. Mizo diacritics are also used inconsistently across the corpus. When we fine tune the NLLB 200 1.3B model on our training data, it scores 27.47 BLEU on a balanced legal test set of 1,000 sentence pairs, an improvement of 7.16 BLEU over the base model. However, it still uses English words about three times more often than a human translator does.

[NLP-14] Graph Topology Meets Energy-Driven Pathfinding: Preserving Contextual Consistency in Retrieval-Augmented Generation EMNLP2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG）框架在处理复杂多跳问答任务时，因知识结构化与推理过程导致的性能瓶颈问题。核心挑战包括：（i）语义损失严重——将连续文本压缩为离散符号会丢失上下文细微差异与叙事连贯性；（ii）模态不匹配显著——碎片化的知识图谱结构与大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）所预训练的连续文本分布不一致，而将其重写为自然语言又引入生成噪声并造成信息遗漏。为此，本文提出一种基于语义-拓扑结构的RAG框架ThreadRAG，其关键在于引入语义拓扑映射器（Semantic Topology Mapper, STM），将检索到的文档组织为保持上下文完整的语义节点，并通过叙事、语义和词汇边构建语义拓扑图（Semantic Topology Graph, STG）。进一步地，采用能量驱动路径规划（Energy-Driven Pathfinding, EDP）机制，通过能量扩散识别与查询相关的子图，并确定性地将其线性化为连贯的文本证据路径，实现原生模态下的证据推理。实验结果表明，ThreadRAG在三个多跳问答基准测试中均显著优于强基线方法，在HotpotQA上相较文本中心方法提升14.4%的精确匹配（EM）得分，在2WikiMultihop上超越最佳基线5.8% EM，同时将令牌消耗降至最强基线的23.3%。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.29933
作者: Yufeng Li,Zaijing Li,Fuchen Zhang,Zongzong Wu,Ming Zhao,Fengxiao Tang
机构: Central South University (中南大学); Harbin Institute of Technology (哈尔滨工业大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026

Abstract:Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frequently integrates knowledge graphs (KGs) for complex multi-hop question answering. However, their performance is increasingly bottlenecked by the knowledge structuring and reasoning processes. (i) Severe semantic loss: Distilling continuous texts into discrete symbols strips away contextual nuances and narrative coherence. (ii) Pronounced modality mismatch: Fragmented graph structures clash with the continuous texts LLMs are pre-trained on, while rewriting them into natural language introduces generative noise and omits information. To address these limitations, we propose ThreadRAG, a semantic-topology-based RAG framework for context-preserving knowledge structuring and modality-native evidence reasoning. ThreadRAG introduces a Semantic Topology Mapper (STM), which organizes retrieved documents into context-intact Semantic Nodes and constructs a Semantic Topology Graph (STG) through narrative, semantic, and lexical edges. It further incorporates Energy-Driven Pathfinding (EDP), which identifies query-relevant subgraphs via energy diffusion and deterministically linearizes them into coherent textual evidence paths. Experiments on three multi-hop QA benchmarks demonstrate that ThreadRAG consistently outperforms strong baselines. Notably, it achieves a 14.4% EM improvement over text-centric methods on HotpotQA and surpasses the best baseline by 5.8% EM on 2WikiMultihop, while reducing token cost to 23.3% of the strongest baseline.

[NLP-15] Your Benchmark Is an Empirical Measure Over Difficulty NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有基准测试（benchmark）评估体系中存在的系统性缺陷，特别是其在衡量模型性能时对难度分布的失准与覆盖不全问题。传统基准测试往往被当作静态的题目集合，而本文提出应将其视为一种基于难度的实证测量工具，由此揭示两大核心失效模式：难度分布错配（measure mismatch），即基准测试的实际难度分布偏离了预期的目标分布；以及覆盖盲区（coverage gaps），即在难度轴上存在未被充分覆盖的区域，导致无法有效监测模型在特定难度区间内的局部进步。为此，论文提出了两个诊断指标，分别量化上述两种失效模式，并提供了严格的理论保障。通过对7个领域中25个主流基准测试的实证分析发现，多数基准测试隐性地高估了某些难度区间的权重，致使排行榜结论需谨慎解读；另一些则在难度轴上存在显著空白，削弱了对模型演进过程的监控能力。最后，论文将诊断结果转化为实际改进方案，提出BenchFill算法——一种面向难度目标的题目重写方法，可有效缩小局部覆盖盲区，提升基准测试的全面性与可靠性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.29927
作者: Yifan Sun,Naicheng Yu,Jiawen Gong,Jingyan Shen,Huan Zhang
机构: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign(伊利诺伊大学厄本那-香槟分校); University of California San Diego(加州大学圣地亚哥分校); New York University(纽约大学)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:A benchmark is not merely a collection of test questions; it naturally induces an empirical measure over difficulty. In this work, we develop this measure-based view of benchmark evaluation. This perspective allows us to identify and formalize two central failure modes: measure mismatch, where the benchmark difficulty distribution differs from the intended difficulty distribution, and coverage gaps, where uncovered regions along the difficulty axis prevent benchmarks from detecting meaningful localized training progress. We propose two diagnostic metrics that capture these two failure modes and provide rigorous theoretical guarantees. Empirically, we analyze 25 popular benchmarks spanning 7 domains using carefully estimated item difficulties. Our results show that many benchmarks implicitly overweight certain difficulty regions, so their leaderboard conclusions should be interpreted with caution; others leave substantial portions of the difficulty axis uncovered, limiting their ability to monitor the model improvement process. Finally, we turn diagnosis into action by introducing BenchFill, a simple difficulty-targeted item rewriting algorithm that effectively reduces local coverage gaps.

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多语言指令微调中模型在目标语言上表现不足、跨语言泛化能力有限的问题，特别是在开放域问答（QA-OEG）任务中，如何有效提升模型在多种目标语言下的生成质量与任务适应性。其解决方案的关键在于采用基于LoRA（Low-Rank Adaptation）的参数高效微调策略，结合两种高质量多语言指令数据集：一是通过任务保持型本地化构建的EuroAlpaca，二是引入跨语言增强机制的CrossEuroAlpaca，该机制在指令、上下文和响应中分配不同源语言与目标语言，以增强模型对多语言语境的理解能力。实验表明，在匹配解码条件下，该方法使目标语言上的QA-OEG任务平均Gemma-4评分相对基础模型提升7.8%；在Aya评估套件上的宏平均ROUGE-L和BERTScore-F1分别提升41.5%和2.9%，且优势主要集中在目标语言。然而，性能提升具有显著的任务与语言依赖性，例如在非目标语言上，部分任务（如基于上下文的问答）性能反而下降，揭示了当前方法在跨语言泛化中的局限性。

Abstract:This paper describes our submission to the WMT 2026 Multilingual Instruction Shared Task. We adapt Qwen3-8B with LoRA using organiser-provided data, EuroAlpaca, a multilingual instruction dataset created through task-preserving localisation, and CrossEuroAlpaca, a cross-lingual augmentation that assigns different source and target languages to instructions, contexts and responses. Our system targets open-ended question answering (QA-OEG) in ten shared-task languages represented in the auxiliary data. Under matched decoding, adaptation improves the mean Gemma-4 judge score on target-language QA-OEG by 7.8% relative to the base model. On an additional evaluation using the Aya Evaluation Suite across all shared-task languages, it yields relative gains of 41.5% in macro-averaged ROUGE-L and 2.9% in BERTScore-F1, with larger improvements in target languages. However, these gains are task- and language-specific. Gemma-4 scores improve for QA-OEG and summarisation in the target languages but decline for context-grounded QA there and across all three tasks in the non-target languages.

[NLP-17] Unintended Side Effects of Value Training in LLM s

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在价值敏感场景中部署时，如何有效实现与人类价值观对齐的问题。当前的价值对齐方法多聚焦于特定价值维度的微调，但其评估范围过于狭窄，未能充分考察此类训练对其他未显式优化能力的影响。研究发现，针对特定价值观进行微调会引发未训练价值维度、风险偏好、社会认知及安全特性等方面的意外副作用，表明价值观之间存在复杂的相互关联性。因此，论文提出关键解决方案在于：在后训练阶段的价值对齐过程中，应引入更广泛的表征行为评估，以全面捕捉模型行为的跨价值迁移效应，并进一步探索将额外价值训练嵌入模型开发流程的最佳位置。

作者: Siddhesh Pawar,Chen Cecilia Liu,Anna Korhonen,Isabelle Augenstein
机构: University of Cambridge (剑桥大学); University of Copenhagen (哥本哈根大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

Abstract:As LLMs are increasingly deployed in value-sensitive contexts, aligning them with human values has emerged as a post-training objective in NLP, aimed at instilling additional values and guiding model behaviour. However, current evaluations remain narrow. Because values are interconnected, it is unclear how fine-tuning for specific values alters unrelated capabilities and behaviours. In this work, we adapt four instruction-tuned LLMs across individual Hofstede’s value dimensions and evaluate them on both cross-value transfer and broader behaviours. We find that value-specific training produces unintended side effects on untrained values, risk preferences, social cognition, and safety traits. Consequently, we suggest that value alignment after post-training should incorporate broader behavioral evaluations, and we highlight the need to investigate where additional value training might best fit into the pipeline.

[NLP-18] Benchmarking Large Language Models for Detecting Satirical Code-Mixed Sentences

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决低资源语言（如罗马尼亚语）中代码混用（code-switching）现象对高级推理任务（如讽刺检测）的负面影响问题，尤其关注生成式AI在捕捉此类语言中细微文化与句法线索方面的不足。其核心挑战在于：现有自然语言处理模型难以有效理解跨语言混合语境下的语义与修辞特征，导致性能显著下降。解决方案的关键在于构建一个大规模、高质量的合成代码混用罗马尼亚语数据集——CS-SeLeRoSa，通过四种方法（随机替换、短语翻译、依存句法分析及大语言模型）生成超过60万条包含英语、德语、法语和意大利语混用的罗马尼亚语句子，并结合人工校验的黄金基准数据集（CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold）进行评估。实验表明，尽管旧版开源模型在零样本场景下表现严重退化（宏平均F1降至37%-55%），但新一代模型如Gemma 4 31B在零样本条件下达到68.1%的准确率，接近前沿模型（如GPT-5 mini的69.5%）；而微调策略能显著减少格式错误并提升性能，使Gemma 4 31B在合成数据集上达到77.5%，在黄金基准上达72.6%，超越多数前沿零样本基线。因此，该研究的关键突破在于通过可控的合成数据增强与模型微调，有效缓解了低资源语言中代码混用带来的建模挑战。

机构: National University of Science and Technology POLITEHNICA Bucharest (布加勒斯特理工大学); Academy of Romanian Scientists (罗马尼亚科学院); Center for Data Science in Humanities, Chosun University (朝鲜大学人文数据科学中心); National Institute for Research Development in Informatics - ICI Bucharest (罗马尼亚信息学研究与发展国家研究所); University of Bucharest (布加勒斯特大学); Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne University (巴黎第一大学)

Abstract:Code-switching is a natural linguistic phenomenon, yet its impact on high-level reasoning tasks remains largely unexplored in under-resourced languages like Romanian. Natural language processing tasks, such as satire detection, rely heavily on nuanced cultural and syntactic cues that large language models struggle to capture. In this paper, we investigate four methods (i.e., random replacement, phrase translation, dependency parsing, and large language models) for generating synthetic code-mixed Romanian sentences with English, German, French, and Italian. We start with an existing dataset for satire detection, compiled from Romanian news articles and annotated at the sentence level by humans, and augment it with over 600k samples, namely CS-SeLeRoSa. We provide an in-depth analysis of the dataset generation process. Then, we evaluate several multilingual large language models across zero-shot, chain-of-thought, and fine-tuning regimes on both the synthetic corpus and a human-adjudicated gold benchmark, namely CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold. While older open models suffer substantial degradation (dropping to 37%-55% macro-F1), newer models like Gemma 4 31B achieve 68.1% zero-shot, rivaling frontier models like GPT-5 mini (69.5%). Furthermore, fine-tuning significantly reduces formatting errors and improves the results, increasing Gemma 4 31B to 77.5% on CS-SeLeRoSa and 72.6% on the gold standard, outperforming frontier zero-shot baselines.

[NLP-19] Investigating the Impact of Learner Errors on Social Bias in Large Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有社会偏见评估基准主要基于流利、语法正确的英语文本，未能充分反映非母语写作者使用语言的实际情况，导致其在偏见表现上被忽视的问题。其核心解决方案在于构建一个受控框架，系统性地向提示词中注入非母语者常见的语法错误，并应用于涵盖性别、种族和宗教等维度的三类社会偏见基准测试。研究发现，语法错误会显著加剧模型的偏见表现，且这种影响随错误率上升而增强；其中，介词误用对刻板印象一致性（stereotype alignment）的影响最为显著且一致。进一步分析表明，当错误更可能干扰理解时，偏见效应更为明显。通过在含错文本上进行微调，可有效缓解由语法错误引发的偏见上升现象。研究揭示，仅基于语法正确提示的偏见评估可能低估了非母语用户在实际使用中所遭遇的真实偏见水平。

Abstract:Existing social bias benchmarks evaluate large language models mostly on fluent, well-formed English, reflecting native speaker usage and leaving non-native writers unrepresented. To address this gap, we investigate how grammatical errors by non-native writers affect social bias. We develop a controlled framework that injects common learner errors into prompts and apply it to three bias benchmarks covering stereotype alignment and demographic preference across gender, race, and religion. We find that grammatical errors increase bias, and the effect grows with the error rate. Among the four common error types we consider, preposition errors produce the largest and most consistent increase in stereotype alignment. Our analysis suggests that errors increase bias when they are more likely to interfere with comprehension. Finally, fine-tuning on erroneous texts reduces the bias increase caused by grammatical errors. Our findings show that bias evaluations based exclusively on well-formed prompts may underestimate the bias experienced by users whose English contains grammatical errors.

[NLP-20] Every Part Has Its Role: Part-of-Speech Effects in LLM Post-Training

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在训练过程中依赖于下一个词预测（Next-Token Prediction, NTP）所带来的语义表达局限性，即模型仅关注具体词元的预测，而未显式建模不同词汇或表达之间的语义相似性。为缓解此问题，现有方法通过引入概念增强（Concept Augmentation），即用语义相关但表达不同的词语替换目标词（如“coach”替换为“trainer”或“instructor”），以丰富模型对概念间关联的理解。然而，先前研究未明确概念信息在句子中所处的词性（Part-of-Speech, POS）位置是否影响其有效性。本文扩展并复现了前人工作，不仅覆盖名词，还系统考察了动词和形容词作为概念信号载体的影响。研究发现：在新闻文本上，无论词性如何，概念增强均能最一致地降低困惑度（perplexity）；而在下游任务性能方面，动词层面的概念增强带来最可靠的提升。尽管如此，基于中心核对齐（CKA）与线性探测的表征分析表明，带来最大下游性能增益的训练条件，并不总是导致模型内部表示发生最显著变化。这一结果揭示：概念增强的有效性不仅取决于概念引入的位置（词性），还受到训练目标与下游任务需求之间匹配程度的影响，提示模型优化需综合考虑语义信息的分布方式与任务特性。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models are typically trained with next-token prediction (NTP), which rewards predicting specific tokens rather than explicitly accounting for the semantic similarities between different words or expressions. Prior work has addressed this limitation by augmenting training data with minimally varying sentences that replace a target word with conceptually related alternatives, e.g., “The tired coach ran home” \rightarrow “The tired trainer ran home”, “The tired instructor ran home”, … Such concept augmentation improves performance, but it remains unclear whether its effectiveness depends on where in the sentence the concept is expressed. We reproduce and extend prior work \textitbeyond nouns to verbs and adjectives, asking whether the part of speech (POS) carrying the concept signal affects perplexity and downstream performance. We find different patterns across evaluation settings: concept augmentation improves perplexity most consistently on news, independent of the POS used, whereas verbs provide the most reliable downstream gains. Despite these behavioral differences, representational analyses using CKA and linear probing show that the conditions yielding the largest downstream gains are not necessarily those that most alter the model’s internal representations. Together, these results suggest that the effectiveness of concept augmentation depends on where and how conceptual information is introduced during training.

[NLP-21] S-EDL: Eliciting Self-Evidence from Sequence Likelihoods for Semantic Calibration of LLM s

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在开放式生成任务中语义校准（semantic calibration）的难题。由于多个不同的词元序列可能表达相同的语义内涵，传统校准方法仅针对固定类别分类置信度或单一字符串的二元正确性，难以适应开放式生成中动态且多样的语义输出特性。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种名为S-EDL的新颖证据理论（evidential method），通过从模型自身的序列似然中提取证据，构建针对特定提示的可微分狄利克雷先验（differentiable Dirichlet prior）以表征提示相关的语义类别。在此先验下优化证据损失，能够生成对可变语义类别具有感知能力的校准训练信号，从而无需依赖固定的多选选项。实验在四个开放式基准测试和三种模型上验证了S-EDL能显著降低语义校准误差并提升准确性，实现了生成似然与语义正确性之间的对齐，为复杂开放场景中可信大语言模型的部署提供了新框架。
