Abstract:In this paper, we develop a unified framework connecting proper scoring rules and Stein’s method for the estimation of unnormalized models. We construct a class of proper scoring rules that encompasses score matching, ratio matching, pseudolikelihood, and noise contrastive estimation. We show that these proper scoring rules naturally induce Stein operators. This connection yields a new construction principle for Stein operators, and enables us to study estimators based on these scoring rules through the geometry associated with the induced Stein operators. Using this geometric perspective, we provide a unified characterization of the asymptotic efficiency of the resulting estimators.

[LG-110] Asynchronous Generation-Free ABC: Streaming AMIS Reweighting for Heterogeneous Simulator Workloads on HPC

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.29506
作者: Julian Herold,Markus Götz,Alexander Schug
类目: Computation (stat.CO); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
*备注: 42 pages (18 main text), 13 figures, 14 tables. Code available at this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Approximate Bayesian computation (ABC) enables Bayesian inference for models with intractable likelihoods by estimating parameter posterior distributions from simulated data. Sequential ABC methods improve sampling efficiency by iteratively adapting the proposal distribution toward regions of high posterior probability. However, these methods typically operate in generations, where each generation must wait for its slowest simulation before the next can begin. On a parallel machine, this synchronization barrier leaves workers idle and reduces throughput, particularly when simulation runtimes vary substantially. We introduce a generation-free ABC sampler that updates its proposal when simulation results arrive and sends a new candidate to each available worker. The proposal is based on the best particles evaluated so far. To estimate the posterior, we reuse the full history and reweight particles against a reconstructed mixture of sampling proposals. We show how errors in approximating the mixture of sampling proposals affect the estimated posterior and establish consistency for the smooth-ABC posterior when the approximation becomes asymptotically exact. In our experiments, the method achieves well-calibrated posterior estimates where a pyABC baseline with the same kernel and bandwidth schedule under-covers. From the asynchronous run’s timing alone, we predict how much a synchronization barrier would slow the sampler. These predictions agree with measured synchronization penalties ranging from 1.2x to 400x. On a Cellular Potts tissue simulator, the asynchronous sampler completes 2.1-2.4x as many evaluations as pyABC in the same hour, and the discrepancy threshold for its best 100 evaluations is 4.1x smaller. With the starting bandwidth set from prior-predictive discrepancies, it also produces a more concentrated two-parameter posterior with a larger effective sample size than pyABC.

[LG-111] When Thoughts Become Memory: Unifying In-Context Learning and Fine-Tuning

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.29419
作者: Leon Chlon,Julie Huang
类目: Machine Learning (stat.ML); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
*备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We are the first to give a certified rule for whether unseen data belong in a pretrained model’s context or its weights, built on an exact law for their information value. That value, the code length saved on held-out queries, equals in expectation the bits stored about the query, plus a prior repair, minus a decoding loss, for any model, architecture, dataset and task. The law’s ceilings certify the choice from one measurement, and an anytime-valid test makes it from held-out queries, with error controlled whenever it stops. Every certificate the ceilings issue on a trained transformer, TabPFN, an occupancy network and a stereo network is correct. The test picks TabPFN over XGBoost and a trained surrogate over an in-context learner on airfoil pressure, calls the better of GPT-2’s cache and fine-tune in 61,948 of 64,000 query streams over 32 comparisons, and errs in at most 3.3% of null streams. The law also diagnoses when learning in context helps and when it does not. Deleting part of a context is held-out validation of that part in any model, and adding parts one at a time traces the learning curve in context: one patch that sees a shape feature cuts an occupancy network’s code length there a hundredfold, while eight that miss it nearly double it, and one camera that sees the surface beats four in a stereo network. Ranked by this label-free valuation, a kriging learner’s three best support cars beat four drawn at random, and on a yes-or-no claim the valuation recovers a published evidence adjudicator, with AUROC 0.91.

[LG-112] Data-driven and physics-guided hindcasting of measured wave spectra

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.29306
作者: Sander Rikka
类目: Atmospheric and Oceanic Physics (physics.ao-ph); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
*备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Short-range hindcasts of measured wave spectra are evaluated using a recurrent model initialized by one hourly buoy spectrum and supplied with local wind, fetch and depth. Measurements from three Baltic Sea stations are combined for training in 2017–2020, validation in 2021 and testing in 2022. ERA5 reanalysis supplies winds throughout the twelve-hour prediction interval. The comparison examines supervision of spectral variance, peak frequency and peak amplitude, followed by empirical wind-sea bounds and a local relaxation constraint. Variance and peak-frequency supervision gives the lowest spectral error within the data-driven comparison, whereas additional peak-amplitude supervision gives the lowest wave-height error. In the matched physical comparison, relaxation reduces height RMSE by 5.01% to \PhPtwoHs~cm. Extending this constraint through hours 13–24, without spectral targets at those hours, reduces primary spectral RMSE by 2.31% to \PhPthreeSpec~ \unitE . Upper-bound constraints increase errors. Wind-condition comparisons show spectral gains from extended relaxation in increasing, decreasing and steady strong winds, with little change in steady weak winds. The results support modest, objective-dependent benefits from local physical guidance. Wave-height scores concern the retained frequency band, and operational forecasting and transfer to independent stations remain to be evaluated.

[LG-113] Group Distributionally Robust Optimization over Decentralized Networks

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.29261
作者: Haomin Bai,Junyan Sun,Quan Cheng,Yuanyu Wan,Lijun Zhang
类目: Optimization and Control (math.OC); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
*备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We study group distributionally robust optimization (GDRO) over decentralized networks, where workers collaborate to learn robust models by minimizing the maximum local risk. Existing methods optimize only dual-regularized surrogates and establish guarantees for a globally averaged model that is not available to workers. In this paper, we directly optimize the original GDRO objective and establish guarantees for local models in semi-decentralized (SemiDec) and fully decentralized (Dec) settings. A key difficulty is that applying the primal-dual decomposition from centralized GDRO yields worker-dependent losses whose evaluation requires unavailable cross-worker information. To address this challenge, we develop a novel error decomposition that recasts decentralized GDRO as (i) a decentralized online convex optimization (D-OCO) problem and a prediction-with-expert-advice problem in SemiDec, and as (ii) two coupled D-OCO problems in Dec, with discrepancy terms capturing inconsistencies among local decisions. By isolating consensus errors in analysis, we develop modular frameworks that support different consensus routines. We then establish the \emphfirst per-worker convergence guarantees for optimizing the original GDRO objective over decentralized networks. Instantiations with accelerated gossip and Choco-gossip achieve an O(\sqrt(\log m)/T) convergence rate over T update rounds, while experiments demonstrate improved worst-worker performance over baselines.

[LG-114] Schrödinger-Bass Bridge Barycenter Models for Measure-Valued Data

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.29227
作者: Ngoc-Hai Nguyen,Thuan Nguyen,Prakash Ishwar,Shuchin Aeron
类目: Machine Learning (stat.ML); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
*备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Barycenter models, based on stochastic and deterministic optimal transport bridges between probability measures, have proven to be useful for supervised and unsupervised learning for (probability) measure-valued data. In this paper, we utilize the directional asymmetry and dual drift-diffusion control arising in the recently proposed Schrödinger-Bass Bridge (SBB) between two measures, and propose \textitSBB-encoder, \textitSBB-decoder, \textitSBB-symmetric, and \textitSBB-Markovian barycenter models. For each of these novel models, our first theoretical result establishes the existence of the SBB-barycenter under mild assumptions. Our second theoretical result characterizes the decoder SBB-barycenter of Gaussians where we show that for Gaussian input measures, the decoder formulation admits a Gaussian minimizer, reducing barycenter computation to a finite-dimensional optimization and yielding a compact algorithm. For general input measures, we derive a hybrid Wasserstein gradient particle descent scheme for all four formulations using the SBB dual representation. Finally, we utilize these algorithms for solving distributional-inverse/interpolation problems arising in the context of spatial images and single-cell RNA sequencing data, where we show that the SBB-decoder and Markovian barycenter allow us to interpolate between successive time points. Results show that our method outperforms existing barycenter models for measure interpolation and inference.

[LG-115] On the gradient conjecture at infinity: Finite spherical length for gradient trajectories of definable potentials

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.29211
作者: Thang Do,Arnulf Jentzen,Benno Kuckuck
类目: Dynamical Systems (math.DS); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Algebraic Geometry (math.AG); Classical Analysis and ODEs (math.CA); Logic (math.LO)
*备注: 98 pages

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We prove that for every open U \subseteq \mathbb R^n the spherical projection of every gradient trajectory \theta(t) , t \geq 0 , of a definable C^1 -potential F \colon U \to \mathbb R has finite length and, in particular, converges (directional convergence). In other words, every gradient trajectory of a definable C^1 -potential has finite total angular motion. Here, definable means definable in an arbitrary o-minimal structure expanding the real field. Notably, the gradient trajectory in this result is an arbitrary solution of the gradient flow differential equation (whose solutions may not be unique) with no further assumptions: The gradient trajectory may be unbounded and diverge to infinity or it may be convergent. The established theorem therefore provides affirmative answers to both the gradient conjecture at infinity for definable potentials and the definable Thom gradient conjecture. We apply our theorem to the training of deep neural networks (DNNs) to conclude that, in the case of definable and continuously differentiable activation and loss functions, the spherical projection of the DNN training flow must always converge (directional convergence). [LG-116] Curvature-Scaled Sharpness-Aware Minimization: Convergence Beyond Smoothness

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.29192
作者: Dimitris Oikonomou,Nicolas Loizou
类目: Optimization and Control (math.OC); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Machine Learning (stat.ML)
*备注: 31 pages

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) has established itself as a widely used method for training deep neural networks. Despite its popularity, existing convergence guarantees for SAM-type methods require smoothness, a restrictive assumption. Generalized smoothness conditions have recently been proposed in the analysis of gradient methods but remain underexplored for SAM. To analyze the effect of SAM’s perturbation under generalized smoothness, we use relative gradient distortion to quantify how the sharpness-aware direction departs from the original gradient. Under (L_0,L_1) -smoothness, we show that this distortion can become unbounded near stationarity for SAM and at large gradients for its unnormalized variant (USAM), with examples where SAM cycles and USAM diverges. We then establish a necessary condition for uniform distortion control among perturbations along the gradient whose nonnegative multipliers depend only on its norm. Motivated by this condition, we propose Curvature-Scaled SAM (CS-SAM), which scales both the perturbation and the descent step by suitable curvature upper bounds, and prove that it uniformly bounds the distortion. Under both (L_0,L_1) - and (H_0,H_1) -smoothness, we establish deterministic \mathcalO(1/T) rates for the best squared gradient norm on nonconvex objectives, last-iterate \mathcalO(1/T) rates for the function gap on convex objectives with a minimizer, and linear convergence under the Polyak-Lojasiewicz condition. With zero perturbation, our guarantees recover the rates for gradient descent with (L_0,L_1) - or (H_0,H_1) -based step-sizes. Minibatch experiments on computer vision tasks demonstrate competitive performance for both variants, with the (H_0,H_1) variant achieving the highest mean best-test accuracy in all four settings against tuned SAM and USAM with constant and cosine annealing schedules.

[LG-117] SU(2)-Equivariant Spinor Message Passing for Molecular Magnetism NEURIPS2026

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.29111
作者: Erh-Wei Sheng,Beom Seok Kang,Yuchao Lin,Danish Khan,Anima Anandkumar
类目: Chemical Physics (physics.chem-ph); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
*备注: An earlier version was accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 SimBioChem Workshop

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Predicting molecular magnetism often requires electronic-structure calculations with spin-orbit coupling (SOC), which are costly to repeat across many molecules. The underlying electronic states can transform as spinors, yet equivariant surrogates typically use only integer-rank features. Inspired by the spinor nature of these electronic states, we develop eSpinor, an SU(2)-equivariant graph neural network that propagates spinor features. We initialize spinor features from eigenvectors of an approximate SOC Hamiltonian and use gauge-covariant message passing with a gauge-invariant readout to make predictions independent of the arbitrary eigenbasis choice. On cobalt single-molecule magnet candidates, eSpinor improves zero-field-splitting predictions relative to NequIP, including for unseen ligands. For a dysprosium magnetic resonance imaging probe, eSpinor improves real electron-spin correlations over a Hamiltonian-informed baseline despite similar static crystal-field errors and fewer parameters, while accurately predicting low-field nuclear relaxation in water and after transfer to methanol without retraining. Overall, these results demonstrate that SU(2)-equivariant spinor message passing is a useful inductive bias for molecular magnetism. We also find that similar static tensor errors can yield different dynamical errors, motivating model selection based on accuracy for the intended physical observables.

[LG-118] Internal Guidance as a Sampling Method for Tilted Diffusion Models

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.29086
作者: Curtis McDonald,Peter Bartlett
类目: Machine Learning (stat.ML); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
*备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Reward guidance methods sample an exponential tilt of a base density using a diffusion model trained with only samples from the base distribution. Existing methods use what we call external guidance: additive terms in the drift or multiplicative terms on the transition probabilities. We propose internal guidance which leaves the output of the base denoiser unmodified and instead changes the point at which it is evaluated. For discrete distributions embedded in the hypercube -1,1^d , the denoiser of any linearly tilted density is exactly the base denoiser evaluated at a shifted and rescaled input. In practice the base denoiser is a neural network trained on noised samples of the base distribution. The required evaluation points for sampling the tilted density would be out-of-distribution for basic noising of the base distribution. We modify the training algorithm with random diagonal rescalings of the data, so that the denoiser network learns both in- and out-of-distribution evaluations of the denoiser relative to the base distribution. A single denoiser network samples binary reward tilts, class labels, and infilling with no fine-tuning and no external guidance term.

[LG-119] A Jump-Modified Wasserstein Gradient Flow for Maximum Mean Discrepancy with Energy Kernels

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.29007
作者: Ansh Desai,Jason Liu,Srujan Roplekar,Matthew Rosenzweig
类目: Analysis of PDEs (math.AP); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Probability (math.PR); Machine Learning (stat.ML)
*备注: 63 pages

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We study a jump-modified Wasserstein gradient flow of the squared maximum mean discrepancy generated by the energy kernels K(z)=-|z|^q , 0q2 , in every dimension d\ge2 as well as the one-dimensional range 1\le q2 . Under subcritical density and finite-moment assumptions, we prove global well-posedness. The added jumps transfer mass toward smaller values of the first variation and dissipate the same MMD energy as the transport term. Under our hypotheses on the target and jump rates, every Borel probability measure with finite MMD energy and zero jump dissipation is equal to the target. Combining this rigidity with compactness and a second-moment identity yields convergence to the target from finite-second-moment data, without additional uniform-in-time density or moment assumptions. We also construct a global collision-free particle process whose energy is nonincreasing along each path. A quantitative mean-field estimate applies to general initial empirical approximations, including deterministic configurations; propagation of chaos for exchangeable data and long-time target approximation follow as consequences.

[LG-120] Is In-Context Reinforcement Learning A Posterior Sampler? An Empirical Study

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28977
作者: Weiqin Chen,Xinlong Du,Gesualdo Scutari,Harsha Honnappa
类目: Machine Learning (stat.ML); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
*备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:In-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) exploits the impressive in-context learning ability of large language models to zero-shot generalize to new, unseen tasks at inference time without any parameter updates. Among many approaches, the Decision-Pretrained Transformer (DPT) is particularly appealing for its theoretical grounding: under idealized assumptions such as a sufficiently expressive model and infinite pretraining data, DPT can perform Bayesian posterior sampling. Whether this characterization survives in practice remains open. Therefore, we ask: \textitis ICRL, specifically DPT and our proposed DPT variants, a Bayesian posterior sampler in practice? To approach this question, we establish two necessary conditions that a Bayesian posterior sampler must satisfy: \textitsufficient-statistic invariance and the \textitmartingale property. We then construct statistical hypothesis tests to statistically assess if practically-trained ICRL models satisfy these conditions. Applying these tests in Gaussian, Bernoulli, and linear bandit settings, we find that both conditions are consistently violated, suggesting that ICRL may not behave as Bayesian posterior samplers in practice. Beyond this negative result, our tests provide a principled toolkit for testing the Bayesian behavior of ICRL.

[LG-121] Backtracking Direct Indirect and Total Effects

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28910
作者: Jose M. Peña
类目: Methodology (stat.ME); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Machine Learning (stat.ML)

Abstract:Natural direct and indirect effects are defined through cross-world interventional counterfactuals. We propose an alternative construction based on backtracking counterfactuals. Rather than intervening on the treatment or mediator, we use a backtracking conditional distribution to construct an alternative exogenous state satisfying a desired treatment-mediator constraint. This yields the backtracking direct and indirect effects, and also the backtracking total effect. Likewise, we adapt the population intervention effects.

[LG-122] ropical Cyclone Attributes in Sparse Autoencoder Features of an AI Weather Model

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28904
作者: Jiapei Liu,Ruidong Li,Ting Sun,Guangheng Ni
类目: Atmospheric and Oceanic Physics (physics.ao-ph); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
*备注: 22 pages, 4 figures; supporting information included as an ancillary file. Submitted to Geophysical Research Letters

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Artificial intelligence (AI) weather models now forecast weather events skillfully, but how they represent these events internally remains unknown. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) provide sparse features for probing hidden states, but how information about multiple physical attributes of an event is organized across them remains unclear. Using tropical cyclones in GraphCast as a test case, we analyze 2,115 six-hourly timesteps from 205 cyclones, relating SAE activations to position, intensity, and pressure structure across five Layer-8 decompositions and 16 processor layers. Each attribute relates to multiple features; position and pressure-structure relations overlap in a smaller subset. This organization recurs across independent SAEs and layers without feature alignment. In deeper layers, the leading position feature aligns better with position and pressure structure six hours ahead than at present. These results suggest that the organization of physical-attribute relations provides a reproducible level of description for interpreting cyclone-related information in GraphCast.

[LG-123] Self-Supervised Tuning of Low-Fidelity Optimization Models via High-Fidelity Feedback

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28851
作者: Gonzalo E. Constante-Flores,André H. Quisaguano-Paredes,Asha Ramanujam,Rishabh Gupta,Can Li
类目: Optimization and Control (math.OC); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
*备注: 50 pages, 6 figures, 13 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Low-fidelity (LF) optimization models are widely used in large-scale operations because they can be solved efficiently and reliably, but they often exhibit systematic errors relative to high-fidelity (HF) formulations that better capture physical and operational constraints. Existing learning-based approaches typically rely on supervised or semi-supervised training with HF solutions, which are expensive to compute and may not align with HF operational objectives. We propose a self-supervised framework that parameterizes LF optimization models directly from HF feedback. The low-fidelity problem is embedded as a differentiable optimization layer and trained end-to-end, while a HF correction problem evaluates its solution and provides gradient information through its dual variables, without requiring HF solution labels. We evaluate the framework on optimal power flow, optimal gas flow, and pooling problems, spanning different sources of low- and high-fidelity mismatch. Across all three applications, the self-supervised approach improves objective quality and feasibility over untuned LF models and generally outperforms semi-supervised training. The learned parameterizations also generalize to unseen operating conditions and, for network applications with up to 30,000 nodes, to systems not encountered during training.

[LG-124] Depth Separation for Neural Networks under Gaussian Measure

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28800
作者: Cynthia Bortolotto,Francisco Ganacim,Roberto I. Oliveira
类目: Machine Learning (stat.ML); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
*备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We revisit the problem of depth separation for neural networks, as studied by Eldan and Shamir, Daniely, and others. Specifically, we consider the natural setting of L^2 approximation of radial functions under the standard Gaussian measure in d dimensions. We show that there is a radial function in L^2 under the standard Gaussian measure that can be approximated to a fixed sufficiently small L^2 error by a depth-3 ReLU neural network of polynomial size in d but can only be approximated by depth-2 networks with subexponentially bounded weights if their size is at least exponential in d . For that, we prove a general result showing that if a radial function has substantial mass in the high frequencies of its Hermite expansion, then it cannot be well approximated by a depth-2 neural network with small width and bounded weights. All theorems, lemmas, propositions, and corollaries are verified in Lean~4.

[LG-125] Understanding the Inner Workings of a State-Space Foundation Model for Limit Order Books

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28753
作者: Valentin Mohl,Alexandre Bismuth,Aramis Marti-Shahandeh,George Nigmatulin,Kang Li,Stefan Zohren,Jakob Foerster,Mihai Cucuringu,Anisoara Calinescu
类目: Trading and Market Microstructure (q-fin.TR); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
*备注: Accepted at the 7th ACM International Conference on AI in Finance (ICAIF '26), November 14-17, 2026, Milan, Italy

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Autoregressive foundation models offer state-of-the-art capabilities to simulate the market by generating the message flow of limit order books (LOBs). Yet, without understanding their inner workings, research directions are hard to narrow and practical use in real-world trading environments remains uncertain. This study therefore asks what these models actually learn about market microstructure. We find that, similarly to games where sequence models build an internal representation of the board, an 8.2M-parameter Mamba-3 state-space model trained autoregressively on the tokenized message stream of eight large-cap US equities learns an internal representation of the market and its dynamics. In particular, order-flow imbalance, a central driver of short-horizon price moves, is decodable at R^2 \approx 0.59 , far above controls and baselines. This representation extends to unseen stocks, suggesting that these models learn general representations rather than ticker-specific patterns. The model also generalizes across metrics beyond order-flow imbalance: results hold across traded volume and volatility. Additionally, the representation is causally steerable: pushing the state along a feature’s axis shifts the model’s next-message beliefs as that feature implies, monotonically in dose, consistent with the emergence of a world model.

[LG-126] Borrowing Strength Across Stores: Transfer Learning for Choice-Based Revenue Management

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28708
作者: Recep Yusuf Bekci,Stefanus Jasin,Joline Uichanco
类目: Machine Learning (stat.ML); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Optimization and Control (math.OC)
*备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large retail chains must tailor assortment and pricing decisions to local customer preferences, yet even retailers with extensive sales records often have limited data for estimating demand at the store or local market level, particularly in product categories with short selling windows. Local estimation (fitting a demand model for each store on its own) can therefore be unreliable, while pooling data across stores improves estimation precision at the cost of ignoring local demand heterogeneity. We study how retailers can balance these competing effects through transfer learning under a multinomial logit (MNL) demand model. We propose a shrinkage estimator that combines store-specific demand estimates with information pooled from other stores. Unlike the linear or quadratic settings underlying much of the existing theoretical literature on information transfer in operations, the nonlinear MNL likelihood does not admit a straightforward bias-variance decomposition. By exploiting its self-concordant-like properties, we establish finite-sample performance guarantees that characterize when information transfer improves demand estimation and how the appropriate degree of shrinkage depends on local sample size, feature dimensionality, and cross-store heterogeneity. We further derive regret bounds for downstream assortment and pricing decisions. Numerical experiments demonstrate the operational benefits of shrinkage across different data environments. An empirical study using data from several hundred stores of a European apparel retailer shows that shrinkage improves out-of-sample product prioritization and revenue capture relative to both local estimation and full pooling. Our findings demonstrate how retailers can leverage information across their store networks to improve revenue management decisions while preserving local demand differences.

[LG-127] Solar System Surface Technosignatures: Searching for Signs of Artificial Design on Extraterrestrial Terrain

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28687
作者: Ana Henrique,Sofia Sheikh,Benjamin Fields
类目: Instrumentation and Methods for Astrophysics (astro-ph.IM); Earth and Planetary Astrophysics (astro-ph.EP); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
*备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Artificial radio emissions have historically been a major focus of technosignature searches. Here, we apply an anthropological lens to expand this scope to surface technosignatures: non-random, intentional patterning on planetary terrain, similar to long-lasting human-made landscapes and monuments on Earth. On geologically inactive bodies such as the Moon and Mars, artificial traces and patterns could potentially remain visible for hundreds of millions of years. We discuss two recent developments that make this search timely: high-resolution imaging datasets, such as those produced by the HiRISE camera on the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO), and ML-based anomaly-detection methods. Finally, we list two possible approaches to developing a model capable of searching for these surface technosignatures: a supervised and an unsupervised one. Complemented by LiDAR, ground-penetrating radar, and reflectance spectroscopy, these methods would enable the first quantitative upper limits on surface technosignatures while yielding ancillary benefits for planetary science.

[LG-128] Machine-learned spectral PDE solvers for fluids and plasmas

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.27317
作者: Mellow Baixuan Chen,Alan A. Kaptanoglu
类目: Computational Physics (physics.comp-ph); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Plasma Physics (physics.plasm-ph)
*备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Sparse regression methods for discovering governing partial differential equations (PDEs) from data are sensitive to observation noise and are not constrained to reproduce the data under forward integration. We address both limitations by performing weak-form discovery in the spatial discretization in which the PDE is solved, learned by differentiating through multistep rollouts anchored at the observed states. The new method, Weak-form Anchored Rollout for PDEs (WARP), produces a machine-learned PDE solver. In this work, we focus on systems amenable to a spectral Galerkin solver. Across eight benchmark fluid and plasma systems, including high-dimensional turbulent simulations, WARP produces numerically stable rollouts from new random initial conditions and substantially improves coefficient recovery, rollout accuracy, and statistical measures compared with a single-step weak-form SINDy baseline.
